vocab_entries.example_sentence: More universities are adopting sustainable transport plans to cut campus carbon emissions.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 越来越多大学正在采用可持续交通方案，以减少校园碳排放。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: A shorter morning commute allows students and staff to arrive on campus feeling more refreshed.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 更短的早间通勤时间能让学生和教职工到达校园时更有精神。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Offering free maintenance served as a strong incentive for students to ride shared bicycles.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 提供免费维修成为鼓励学生骑行共享单车的有力激励措施。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: The city council plans to implement stricter parking rules near major subway stations next month.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 市议会计划下个月在主要地铁站附近实施更严格的停车规定。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Expanding dedicated bike lanes helped ease morning traffic congestion along the main avenue.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 扩建专用自行车道有助于缓解主干道早高峰的交通拥堵。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Constant phone notifications act as a major distraction during deep reading sessions.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 不断的手机通知在深度阅读期间会成为主要的分心干扰。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Taking brief handwritten notes often improves reading comprehension more than passive highlighting.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 做简短的手写笔记往往比被动划重点更能提高阅读理解能力。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Several surveys point to a steady decline in the time young adults spend reading printed books.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 多项调查显示，年轻人阅读纸质书籍的时间正在稳步下降。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Students who review new vocabulary across several days retain far more words than cramming overnight.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 跨多天复习新词汇的学生比熬夜突击记忆能记住多得多的单词。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Consistent daily practice of even fifteen minutes can steadily boost listening accuracy.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 哪怕每天坚持十五分钟的持续练习，也能稳步提高听力准确率。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Urban planners are testing innovative indoor farms inside converted office buildings.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 城市规划者正在改造后的办公楼内测试创新的室内农场。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Closed-loop hydroponic systems consume up to ninety percent less water than open fields.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 闭环水培系统比露天农田少消耗高达百分之九十的水资源。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Controlled lighting and temperature can double the annual yield of leafy vegetables.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 可控的光照和温度能使绿叶蔬菜的年产量翻倍。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Installing smart sensors helps campuses conserve electricity during holidays.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 安装智能传感器有助于校园在假期期间节约用电。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Growing produce closer to urban supermarkets creates a more efficient supply chain.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 在靠近城市超市的地方种植农产品能够打造更高效的供应链。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Many companies now offer flexible schedules so employees can balance family and work.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 许多公司如今提供弹性工作时间，以便员工平衡家庭与工作。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Designers and engineers collaborate closely to solve usability challenges early.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 设计师和工程师紧密协作，以尽早解决可用性难题。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Clear weekly goals can raise team productivity without extending total working hours.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 明确的每周目标可以在不延长总工时的情况下提高团队效率。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Working purely from home for months can leave new graduates feeling isolated from mentors.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 连续几个月完全居家办公可能会让应届毕业生感到与导师疏离。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Freshmen need practical guidance to adapt smoothly to independent university study.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 大一新生需要实用的指导，才能顺利适应独立的大学学习。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Rather than abandon the project, the club scaled down its scope to finish on time.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 社团没有放弃这个项目，而是缩小了规模以便按时完成。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Visual diagrams help students turn abstract grammar rules into memorable patterns.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 可视化图表帮助学生把抽象的语法规则转化为易于记忆的模式。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: High-speed rail networks have accelerated economic exchange between neighboring regions.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 高铁网络加快了邻近地区之间的经济交流。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Public libraries make reliable research databases accessible to every citizen.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 公共图书馆让每位市民都能使用可靠的学术数据库。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: The newly renovated lecture hall can accommodate up to four hundred students.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 新翻修的阶梯教室最多可容纳四百名学生。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Scientists acknowledge that long-term climate studies still require more ocean data.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 科学家们承认，长期气候研究仍然需要更多海洋数据。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Learners acquire practical listening instincts by hearing natural speech in context.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 学习者通过在语境中听取自然语音来习得实用的听力语感。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Without adequate rest before exams, memory recall drops noticeably.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 考前如果没有充足的休息，记忆提取能力会明显下降。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: The app automatically adjusts daily review volume when your exam date gets closer.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 随着考试日期临近，这款应用会自动调整每日复习量。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Many nutritionists advocate eating whole grains instead of heavily processed snacks.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 许多营养学家提倡食用全谷物，而非深加工零食。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Background noise in a crowded cafe can negatively affect your listening accuracy.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 拥挤咖啡馆里的背景噪音会对你的听力准确率产生负面影响。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: With tight study schedules, few students can afford to waste time on low-yield drills.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 由于学习日程紧张，很少有学生负担得起把时间浪费在低效刷题上。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Smart learners allocate more minutes to weak skills rather than repeating easy sections.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 聪明的备考者会把更多分钟数分配给薄弱技能，而不是重复做简单板块。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Podcasts provide a practical alternative when you cannot read printed English on a bus.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 当你在公交车上无法阅读纸质英语时，播客提供了一个实用的替代选择。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Setting an ambitious yet realistic target keeps learners motivated through the final month.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 设定一个既有抱负又切合实际的目标，能让学习者在最后一个月保持动力。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Reviewers analyze why wrong options look tempting before moving on to the next passage.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 复盘者会在进入下一篇文章前分析为什么干扰项看起来很有诱惑力。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: The university holds an annual book fair on the central lawn every October.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 这所大学每年十月都会在中心草坪举办年度书展。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Experienced listeners anticipate key transitions right after words like however or actually.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 有经验的听力考生会在 however 或 actually 等词出现后立即预判关键转折。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: It soon became apparent that regular short sessions outperformed occasional marathon cramming.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 很快就可以看出，规律的短时学习胜过偶尔的马拉松式突击。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Locating keywords in the paragraph first is a reliable approach to CET-4 reading questions.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 先在段落中定位关键词是解答四级阅读题的一种可靠方法。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Choosing an appropriate time slot ensures you can complete a full micro-task without rushing.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 选择合适的时间档能确保你从容完成一个完整的微任务。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Weekly mixed tests help assess listening and reading accuracy under realistic timing.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 每周混合测试有助于在真实计时条件下评估听力和阅读准确率。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Do not assume an option is right just because it repeats a familiar word from the passage.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 不要因为某个选项重复了文章里的熟悉词汇，就假定它是正确的。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Many teachers attribute steady improvement in reading speed to daily exposure to quality texts.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 许多老师将阅读速度的稳步提升归因于每天接触高质量文本。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Offline audio tracks remain available even when you study on a subway without signal.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 即使你在没有信号的地铁上学习，离线音频轨道依然可用。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Spaced repetition is especially beneficial for retaining easily confused academic words.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 间隔重复对于记住易混淆的学术词汇尤其有益。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Completing a three-minute review before class can boost both focus and confidence.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 课前完成一次三分钟复习既能提升专注力，也能增强信心。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Student volunteers launched a campus campaign to cut single-use plastic cups.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 学生志愿者发起了减少一次性塑料杯的校园宣传活动。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: The library reading room operates at full capacity during the final week before exams.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 考前最后一周，图书馆阅览室处于满负荷运行状态。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Understanding fast connected speech poses a common challenge for intermediate learners.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 听懂快速的连读语音对中等水平的学习者来说是一个常见挑战。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Under normal circumstances, the campus shuttle runs every ten minutes between gates.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 正常情况下，校园班车每十分钟在各校门之间发车一次。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: The professor paused to clarify the grading criteria before students began the essay.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 在学生开始写论文之前，教授停下来阐明了评分标准。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Effective learners combine active listening with immediate transcript verification.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 高效的学习者会把精听与即时的原文核对结合起来。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Even students who can only commit twenty minutes a day make steady gains over a month.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 哪怕每天只能投入二十分钟的学生，一个月下来也能取得稳步进步。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Neighborhood gardens bring residents together and supply fresh greens to the local community.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 社区菜园把居民凝聚在一起，并为当地社区提供新鲜蔬菜。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Always compare your own summary against the original paragraph to spot subtle distortions.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 务必把你的总结与原文段落对比，以发现细微的曲解。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Quick guesswork cannot compensate for weak vocabulary during the reading section.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 在阅读部分，仓促猜测无法弥补词汇量的薄弱。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Turning off background alerts helps you concentrate on the speaker's main conclusion.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 关闭后台提醒有助于你集中精力听说话人的主要结论。

collocations: as far as I am concerned
vocab_entries.example_sentence: Educators voiced concern over the drop in students' sustained attention spans.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 教育工作者对学生持续注意力下降表达了担忧。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Researchers concluded that balanced sleep schedules improve morning recall scores.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 研究人员得出结论：均衡的作息能提高晨间记忆测试成绩。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: The student union conducted a week-long survey on library seating availability.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 学生会开展了一项为期一周的图书馆座位使用情况调查。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Because of a schedule conflict, the debate club moved its weekly meeting to Thursday evening.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 由于日程冲突，辩论社把每周例会改到了周四晚上。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Skipping error analysis has an immediate consequence: the same mistake reappears next week.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 跳过错题分析有一个直接后果：下周还会犯同样的错误。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Switching to active recall saved learners a considerable amount of review time.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 改用主动回忆法为学习者节省了可观的复习时间。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Keeping a constant pace matters more than sprinting on day one and quitting on day four.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 保持稳定节奏比第一天猛冲、第四天放弃更重要。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Daily short listening drills contribute directly to faster spoken-word recognition.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 每天简短的听力训练直接有助于更快速地识别口语词汇。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Banning laptops in lecture halls proved controversial among engineering students.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 在阶梯教室禁止使用笔记本电脑的提议在工科生中引发了争议。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Unlike conventional soil farming, vertical racks stack crops upward inside warehouses.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 与传统土壤耕作不同，垂直种植架在仓库内向上叠放作物。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Clear sample data finally convinced the department to fund the peer-tutoring lab.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 清晰的样本数据最终说服了院系资助同伴辅导实验室。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Checking the exact evidence sentence is crucial for avoiding subtle reading traps.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 核对准确的证据句对于避开隐蔽的阅读陷阱至关重要。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Staying curious about why a synonym works builds deeper reading intuition.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 对同义替换为何成立保持好奇心，能培养更深厚的阅读语感。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Whether AI tools belong in freshman writing courses remains a topic of lively debate.
vocab_entries.example_translation: AI 工具是否适合进入大一写作课仍是一个热烈讨论的话题。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Pilot results demonstrate that three-minute review bursts improve retention across a week.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 试点结果表明，三分钟短时复习脉冲能提升一周内的记忆保持率。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Many academic English words derive from Latin or Greek roots that share predictable meanings.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 许多学术英语词汇源自具有可预测含义的拉丁语或希腊语词根。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Context clues often determine which meaning of a multi-sense word fits the sentence.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 上下文线索往往决定一个多义词的哪种释义符合当前句子。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: If you devote ten focused minutes to translation each evening, syntax errors shrink fast.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 如果你每晚投入十分钟专心做翻译训练，句法错误会很快减少。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Breaking large goals into small checkpoints can diminish pre-exam anxiety.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 把大目标拆分成小关卡能够减轻考前焦虑。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Learners must distinguish between what the author states and what a distractor exaggerates.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 学习者必须区分作者陈述的内容与干扰项夸大的内容。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Listening to diverse voices prepares candidates for varied accents in audio passages.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 听不同声音有助于考生适应听力篇章中的多样口音。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Domestic rail tourism grew rapidly as travelers favored scenic weekend routes.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 随着游客青睐周末风景线路，国内铁路旅游迅速增长。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: New study groups began to emerge in dorm lounges ahead of the December exam.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 十二月考试临近，宿舍休息室里开始出现新的学习小组。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: The coach emphasized checking transition words before picking an answer.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 老师强调在选择答案前要先留意转折词。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Saved checkpoints enable commuters to pause mid-passage and resume later without losing progress.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 保存的断点让通勤者可以在文章中途暂停，并在之后继续学习而不丢失进度。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Whenever you encounter an unfamiliar verb in reading, check its subject and object first.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 在阅读中每当遇到生疏动词时，先看它的主语和宾语。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Adding brief Chinese explanations can enhance beginners' willingness to review mistakes.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 加入简明中文解析能够提高初学者复盘错题的意愿。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Double-checking timestamps ensures that audio replay jumps to the exact spoken clue.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 仔细核对时间戳能确保音频回放精准跳转到口语线索句。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Knowing high-frequency verbs is essential for understanding both headlines and long passages.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 掌握高频动词对于理解新闻标题和长篇文章都至关重要。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Establish a fixed ten-minute morning habit before adding extra evening practice.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 在增加额外晚间练习前，先建立固定的晨间十分钟学习习惯。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Readers need to evaluate whether a claim is backed by data or merely personal opinion.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 读者需要评估某个观点究竟有数据支撑，还是仅仅出自个人看法。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Every reading question should point directly to verifiable textual evidence in the passage.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 每一道阅读题都应该直接指向文章中可核验的文本证据。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Recommended micro-tasks should never exceed eighty-five percent of your available time.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 推荐的微任务时长不应超过你可用时间的百分之八十五。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Reading short non-fiction articles helps expand academic vocabulary naturally.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 阅读简短的非虚构类文章有助于自然地扩充学术词汇量。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Repeated exposure to a word in listening and reading locks it into long-term memory.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 在听力和阅读中反复接触同一个词，会把它牢牢锁进长期记忆。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Clear paragraph numbers facilitate rapid cross-checking between questions and text.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 清晰的段落编号便于在题目和文本之间快速交叉核对。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Sleep quality is an often overlooked factor in daytime listening focus.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 睡眠质量是白天听力专注力中一个常被忽视的因素。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: The campus museum will feature historical maps in its spring exhibition.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 校园博物馆将在春季展览中重点展出历史地图。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Rooftop solar panels generate nearly a third of the greenhouse's daytime power.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 屋顶太阳能电池板为温室提供了白天将近三分之一的电力。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: No app can guarantee an exam score, but disciplined daily review builds real skill.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 没有任何应用能保证考试分数，但自律的每日复习能练就真实能力。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Learners highlight the exact sentence that supports their answer before submitting.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 学习者在提交前会标出支撑自己答案的准确句子。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: Reducing food transport miles has a measurable impact on urban carbon emissions.
vocab_entries.example_translation: 减少食物运输里程对城市碳排放有着可衡量的影响。

vocab_entries.example_sentence: In college English reading, the collocation "chinese government" frequently expresses "中国政府".
vocab_entries.example_translation: 在大学英语阅读中，搭配“chinese government”常用来表达“中国政府”（核心词义：政府）。

vocab_quizzes.stem: Choose the closest Chinese meaning for "sustainable" in: "Universities are adopting sustainable transport plans."
vocab_quizzes.explanation_zh: sustainable 意为“可持续的、能长期维持的”，常见搭配 sustainable development / sustainable transport。
distractor_reasons: 正确：sustainable 表示“可持续的”，符合绿色交通语境。
错误：“临时的”对应 temporary，与 sustainable 语义相反。
错误：“昂贵的”对应 expensive / costly，原文未提及价格。
错误：“复杂的”对应 complex / complicated，词义不符。

vocab_quizzes.stem: Free bicycle repairs served as a strong ____ for students to ride instead of driving.
vocab_quizzes.explanation_zh: incentive 表示“激励、鼓励措施”，serve as an incentive for sb. to do sth. 是四级高频搭配。
distractor_reasons: 正确：incentive 意为“激励措施”，符合“免费修车鼓励骑行”的逻辑。
错误：congestion 意为“拥堵”，与“鼓励学生骑车”搭配不当。
错误：distraction 意为“分心事物”，带有干扰义，不符合句意。
错误：conflict 意为“冲突”，无法说明免费修车的推动作用。

vocab_quizzes.stem: What does "implement" mean in "implement stricter parking rules"?
vocab_quizzes.explanation_zh: implement 作动词意为“实施、贯彻、执行”，常接 policy / rules / reforms。
distractor_reasons: 正确：implement a rule 表示“实施/执行某项规定”。
错误：“取消；废除”对应 cancel / abolish。
错误：“忽视”对应 ignore / overlook。
错误：“质疑；反对”对应 question / oppose。

vocab_quizzes.stem: Listen to the word pronunciation and pick the matching word meaning “拥堵；堵塞”.
vocab_quizzes.explanation_zh: congestion /kənˈdʒes.tʃən/ 意为“拥堵、堵塞”，注意与 conclusion（结论）区分音形。
distractor_reasons: 正确：congestion 意为“拥堵”，常见搭配 traffic congestion。
错误：conclusion 意为“结论”，属于形近词干扰。
错误：contribution 意为“贡献”，词义与发音均不同。
错误：convention 意为“惯例；大会”，词义不符。

vocab_quizzes.stem: Students who review words across several days ____ far more vocabulary than overnight crammers.
vocab_quizzes.explanation_zh: retain 意为“保持、记住”，retain vocabulary / retain information 是学习科学阅读高频搭配。
distractor_reasons: 正确：retain 表示“记住、保留”，与“多天复习效果更好”相吻合。
错误：abandon 意为“放弃”，语义相反。
错误：decline 意为“下降；婉拒”，不能直接接 vocabulary 表示记住。
错误：isolate 意为“孤立”，语义不通。

vocab_quizzes.stem: In "double the annual yield of leafy vegetables", "yield" is closest in meaning to:
vocab_quizzes.explanation_zh: yield 在农业/经济语境中作名词意为“产量、产出”，同义词为 output / harvest。
distractor_reasons: 正确：output 意为“产量、产出”，与 crop yield 同义替换。
错误：cost 意为“成本”，与产量无关。
错误：risk 意为“风险”，语义不符。
错误：delay 意为“延误”，语义不符。

vocab_quizzes.stem: Which verb means “节约；保护（水、能源等资源）”?
vocab_quizzes.explanation_zh: conserve 意为“节约、保护”，注意与 consume（消耗）区分，二者前缀相同但意思相反。
distractor_reasons: 正确：conserve water / energy 表示“节约水/能源”。
错误：consume 意为“消耗、消费”，是常见形近反义干扰项。
错误：conflict 意为“冲突”，词义不符。
错误：convince 意为“说服”，词义不符。

vocab_quizzes.stem: Loud background music can negatively ____ your reading concentration.
vocab_quizzes.explanation_zh: 此处需要动词原形作谓语，affect 为动词“影响”；effect 通常作名词“效果/影响”，是四级经典易混词对。
distractor_reasons: 正确：affect 是动词，can negatively affect 表示“可能产生负面影响”。
错误：effect 常见词性为名词（have an effect on），直接作“影响”谓语动词不符合常规四级考法。
错误：afford 意为“负担得起”，语义不通。
错误：adapt 意为“适应”，通常搭配 adapt to。

vocab_quizzes.stem: Choose the closest meaning for "allocate" in "allocate more minutes to weak skills":
vocab_quizzes.explanation_zh: allocate 表示“分配、拨出（时间、资金、资源）”，常与 to 搭配：allocate A to B。
distractor_reasons: 正确：allocate time to 表示“把时间分配给……”。
错误：“忽略；删除”对应 ignore / delete。
错误：“推迟”对应 postpone / delay。
错误：“夸大”对应 exaggerate。

vocab_quizzes.stem: Listen and choose the word meaning “预期；预料”.
vocab_quizzes.explanation_zh: anticipate /ænˈtɪs.ɪ.peɪt/ 意为“预期、预料”，常见于听力预判和阅读因果句。
distractor_reasons: 正确：anticipate 意为“预期、预料”。
错误：participate 意为“参与”，常考词形相近干扰。
错误：accommodate 意为“容纳、提供住宿”。
错误：compensate 意为“弥补、赔偿”。

vocab_quizzes.stem: Many teachers ____ steady reading progress to consistent daily exposure.
vocab_quizzes.explanation_zh: attribute A to B 意为“把 A 归因于 B”；contribute to 则是“促成、有助于”，注意“归因方向”完全不同！
distractor_reasons: 正确：attribute progress to daily exposure 表示“把进步归因于每天接触”。
错误：contribute A to B 表示“把 A 贡献给 B”，若填 contribute 应为 exposure contributes to progress。
错误：distribute 意为“分发、分配”，语义不符。
错误：constitute 意为“构成、组成”，不与 to 搭配表示归因。

vocab_quizzes.stem: In "saved a considerable amount of time", "considerable" means:
vocab_quizzes.explanation_zh: considerable 意为“相当大的、可观的”，同义词为 substantial / significant；注意不要与 considerate（体贴的）混淆。
distractor_reasons: 正确：substantial 意为“相当大的、可观的”，可与 considerable 同义替换。
错误：considerate 意为“体贴的、考虑周到的”，是四级高频形近陷阱词。
错误：tiny 意为“微小的”，与原意相反。
错误：uncertain 意为“不确定的”，词义无关。

vocab_quizzes.stem: Short daily listening drills ____ directly to faster word recognition.
vocab_quizzes.explanation_zh: contribute to 表示“促成、有助于”，主语是原因（短时训练），宾语是结果（更快认词）。
distractor_reasons: 正确：contribute to 意为“促成、有助于”，符合因果方向。
错误：attribute 需要宾语再加 to（attribute 结果 to 原因），此处是不及物用法。
错误：object to 意为“反对”，语义相反。
错误：react to 意为“对……作出反应”，不符合句意。

vocab_quizzes.stem: What does "conventional" mean in "conventional soil farming"?
vocab_quizzes.explanation_zh: conventional 意为“传统的、常规的”，注意不要受 convenient（方便的）外形干扰！
distractor_reasons: 正确：conventional 表示“传统的、常规的”，与垂直农场形成对比。
错误：“便利的；方便的”对应 convenient，是高频拼写混淆项。
错误：“极端的”对应 extreme / radical。
错误：“临时的”对应 temporary。

vocab_quizzes.stem: Which word is closest in meaning to "diminish" in "diminish pre-exam anxiety"?
vocab_quizzes.explanation_zh: diminish 意为“减少、削弱”，在四级阅读同义替换中常对应 reduce / decrease / lessen。
distractor_reasons: 正确：reduce 意为“减少、减轻”，与 diminish 同义。
错误：increase 意为“增加”，意思相反。
错误：ignore 意为“忽视”，不是减少。
错误：create 意为“产生、制造”，意思相反。

vocab_quizzes.stem: Choose the verb that means “区分；辨别” in "____ between facts and opinions":

distractor_reasons: 正确：distinguish between 表示“区分两者”。
错误：diminish 意为“减少”，不搭配 between。
错误：demonstrate 意为“证明、演示”。
错误：determine 意为“决定、确定”。

vocab_quizzes.stem: Listen and select the word meaning “促进；使便利”.

错误：hesitate 意为“犹豫”。

vocab_quizzes.stem: Recommended daily tasks should not ____ eighty-five percent of your available minutes.
vocab_quizzes.explanation_zh: exceed 意为“超过（限度、预算、数量）”，注意区分同根词根 -ceed/-cede 家族：succeed（成功）、proceed（继续）、concede（让步）。
distractor_reasons: 正确：exceed eighty-five percent 表示“超过 85%”。
错误：succeed 意为“成功；继任”，不及物时加 in。
错误：proceed 意为“继续进行”，不直接接百分比作“超过”。
错误：concede 意为“承认；让步”，语义不符。

vocab_quizzes.stem: Complete the CET-4 collocation meaning “可持续的”: "____ development"

vocab_quizzes.explanation_zh: joint /dʒɔɪnt/ (adj.) 意为“联合的；连接的”；常见搭配：joint venture (合资企业)。
distractor_reasons: 错误：royal 意为“王的”，不合语境。
正确：填入 joint（联合的）搭配与语义准确。
错误：religious 意为“宗教的”，不合语境。
错误：rotten 意为“腐烂的”，不合语境。

vocab_quizzes.stem: Choose the closest Chinese meaning for "pension" (n. /ˈpɛnʃən/):
vocab_quizzes.explanation_zh: pension /ˈpɛnʃən/ (n.) 意为“养老金；抚恤金”；常见搭配：pension fund (养老基金)。
distractor_reasons: 错误：“抑制”是 restraint 的词义。
错误：“树干”是 trunk 的词义。
正确：pension (n.) 意为“养老金”。
错误：“姓”是 surname 的词义。

vocab_quizzes.stem: Which CET-4 word (v.) means “雇佣”?
vocab_quizzes.explanation_zh: hire /ˈhaɪɚ/ (v.) 意为“雇佣；租用”；常见搭配：for hire (供出租)。
distractor_reasons: 正确：hire /ˈhaɪɚ/ 表示“雇佣”。
错误：mix 意为“使混合”。
错误：shave 意为“剃”。
错误：tolerate 意为“忍受”。

vocab_quizzes.stem: Listen to the pronunciation and select the word meaning “解释”:
vocab_quizzes.explanation_zh: explanation /.ekspləˈneiʃən/ (n.) 意为“解释；说明”；常见搭配：in explanation of (解释)。
distractor_reasons: 错误：shuttle 意为“穿梭”。
错误：sweat 意为“汗”。
正确：发音 /.ekspləˈneiʃən/ 对应单词 explanation（解释）。
错误：adjective 意为“形容词”。

vocab_quizzes.stem: Complete the CET-4 collocation meaning “熟悉的”: "____ with"
vocab_quizzes.explanation_zh: familiar /fəˈmiljə/ (adj.) 意为“熟悉的；常见的”；常见搭配：familiar with (熟悉)。
distractor_reasons: 错误：useless 意为“无用的”，不合语境。
正确：填入 familiar（熟悉的）搭配与语义准确。
错误：aware 意为“知道的”，不合语境。
错误：manly 意为“男子气概的”，不合语境。

vocab_quizzes.stem: Choose the closest Chinese meaning for "consist" (v. /kənˈsɪst/):
vocab_quizzes.explanation_zh: consist /kənˈsɪst/ (v.) 意为“由……组成；由…组成”；常见搭配：consist of (由…构成)。
distractor_reasons: 正确：consist (v.) 意为“由……组成”。
错误：“加宽”是 widen 的词义。
错误：“包含”是 include 的词义。
错误：“减少”是 reduce 的词义。

vocab_quizzes.stem: Which CET-4 word (adj.) means “保守的”?
vocab_quizzes.explanation_zh: conservative /kənˈsɝvətɪv/ (adj.) 意为“保守的；传统的”；常见搭配：conservative party (n. 保守党)。
distractor_reasons: 错误：gratitude 意为“感激”。
正确：conservative /kənˈsɝvətɪv/ 表示“保守的”。
错误：blank 意为“空白的”。
错误：unsatisfactory 意为“不令人满意的”。

vocab_quizzes.stem: Listen to the pronunciation and select the word meaning “男演员”:
vocab_quizzes.explanation_zh: actor /ˈæktə/ (n.) 意为“男演员；演剧的人”；常见搭配：best actor (最佳男主角)。
distractor_reasons: 错误：likelihood 意为“可能”。
错误：outskirt 意为“外边”。
错误：hawk 意为“鹰”。
正确：发音 /ˈæktə/ 对应单词 actor（男演员）。

vocab_quizzes.stem: Complete the CET-4 collocation meaning “有价值的人(或物)资产”: "____ management"
vocab_quizzes.explanation_zh: asset /ˈæsɛt/ (n.) 意为“有价值的人(或物)资产；资产”；常见搭配：asset management (资产管理)。
distractor_reasons: 正确：填入 asset（有价值的人(或物)资产）搭配与语义准确。
错误：government 意为“政府”，不合语境。
错误：tomb 意为“坟墓”，不合语境。
错误：curl 意为“卷毛”，不合语境。

vocab_quizzes.stem: Choose the closest Chinese meaning for "birth" (n. /bə:θ/):
vocab_quizzes.explanation_zh: birth /bə:θ/ (n.) 意为“分娩；出生”；常见搭配：give birth (生孩子)。
distractor_reasons: 正确：birth (n.) 意为“分娩”。
错误：“垫”是 pad 的词义。
错误：“点心”是 refreshment 的词义。
错误：“梦”是 dream 的词义。

vocab_quizzes.stem: Which CET-4 word (n.) means “民主”?
vocab_quizzes.explanation_zh: democracy /dɪˈmɑkrəsi/ (n.) 意为“民主；民主制”；常见搭配：social democracy (n. 社会主义)。
distractor_reasons: 正确：democracy /dɪˈmɑkrəsi/ 表示“民主”。
错误：usage 意为“使用”。
错误：alloy 意为“合金”。
错误：trumpet 意为“喇叭”。

vocab_quizzes.stem: Listen to the pronunciation and select the word meaning “邀请”:
vocab_quizzes.explanation_zh: invite /inˈvait/ (v.) 意为“邀请；聘请”；常见搭配：invite public bidding (（公开）招标)。
distractor_reasons: 错误：sway 意为“影响”。
错误：represent 意为“代表”。
错误：glance 意为“看一下”。
正确：发音 /inˈvait/ 对应单词 invite（邀请）。

listening_cases.title: Campus Smart Shuttle & Bike-Lane Launch
listening_cases.title_zh: 校园智能接驳车与自行车专用道启用新闻

transcript_lines.speaker: News Anchor
transcript_lines.text: Good morning. Starting this Monday, Riverdale University is opening a three-kilometer dedicated bicycle lane connecting the north dormitories to the main science library.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 早上好。从本周一开始，河谷大学将启用一条全长三公里、连接北区宿舍与主科学图书馆的自行车专用道。

transcript_lines.speaker: News Anchor
transcript_lines.text: Campus planners originally proposed banning private cars near lecture halls altogether.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 校园规划方最初曾提议在教学楼附近全面禁止私家车通行。

transcript_lines.speaker: News Anchor
transcript_lines.text: However, after surveying over two thousand students and staff, the university decided instead to offer free fifteen-minute shared bike rides during morning rush hours.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 然而，在调查了两千多名师生后，学校决定改为在早高峰时段提供十五分钟内免费的共享单车骑行。

transcript_lines.speaker: News Anchor
transcript_lines.text: Officials expect the program to cut morning shuttle waiting lines by nearly forty percent this semester.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 校方预计该项目将在本学期使早间校车排队时间减少近百分之四十。

questions.stem: What did Riverdale University decide to do instead of banning private cars near lecture halls?
options: Offer free short shared bike rides during morning rush hours.
Double the parking fee for all campus visitors.
Close the north dormitories for renovation.
Cancel morning shuttle buses for one semester.
questions.answer: Offer free short shared bike rides during morning rush hours.

evidence_anchor.text_span: However, after surveying over two thousand students and staff, the university decided instead to offer free fifteen-minute shared bike rides during morning rush hours.

questions.key_evidence_line: However, after surveying over two thousand students and staff, the university decided instead to offer free fifteen-minute shared bike rides during morning rush hours.
questions.explanation_zh: 典型四级短新闻“转折替代”考点：先提最初提议（banning private cars），随后用 However... decided instead 引出最终措施——早高峰提供15分钟免费共享单车。
distractor_reasons: 正确：原文第3句 However 后明确提到 decided instead to offer free fifteen-minute shared bike rides during morning rush hours。
错误：文中未提及提高访客停车费，属于无中生有。
错误：第1句提到北区宿舍是自行车道起点，并未说关闭翻修。
错误：第4句是预计减少校车排队时间（cut waiting lines），并非取消校车。

questions.stem: What does the new three-kilometer bike lane connect?
options: The north dormitories and the main science library.
The city subway station and the sports stadium.
The dining hall and the south faculty apartments.
The lecture halls and the downtown shopping center.
questions.answer: The north dormitories and the main science library.

evidence_anchor.text_span: Starting this Monday, Riverdale University is opening a three-kilometer dedicated bicycle lane connecting the north dormitories to the main science library.

questions.key_evidence_line: Starting this Monday, Riverdale University is opening a three-kilometer dedicated bicycle lane connecting the north dormitories to the main science library.
questions.explanation_zh: 新闻导语（第1句）往往包含地点与起止信息：connecting the north dormitories to the main science library。
distractor_reasons: 正确：第1句清晰交代连接北区宿舍与主科学图书馆。
错误：地铁站与体育馆未在新闻中出现。
错误：食堂与南区教工公寓属于无关地点替换。
错误：市中心商业区未被提及。

listening_cases.title: Changing the Evening Study Plan
listening_cases.title_zh: 长对话：调整晚间四级备考与小组讨论方案

transcript_lines.speaker: Maya
transcript_lines.text: Hey Leo, are we still meeting at the noisy student cafe at seven to review CET-4 listening?
transcript_lines.text_zh: 嗨 Leo，我们今晚七点还去那个吵闹的学生咖啡馆复习四级听力吗？

transcript_lines.speaker: Leo
transcript_lines.text: Actually, I had to cancel that spot. Last time the espresso machine made it almost impossible to hear the speaker's transitions.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 其实我把那个地方取消了。上次咖啡机的声音大得根本听不清说话人的转折词。

transcript_lines.speaker: Maya
transcript_lines.text: True. Should we reserve a quiet study room on the third floor of the library instead?
transcript_lines.text_zh: 确实。那我们要不要改订图书馆三楼的安静研讨室？

transcript_lines.speaker: Leo
transcript_lines.text: I checked earlier, and all library rooms are booked for final projects. Good thing is, my department lounge stays open and empty after six thirty.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 我早些时候查过了，图书馆所有房间都因为期末项目被订满了。好消息是，我们院系休息室六点半以后开放且很安静没人。

transcript_lines.speaker: Maya
transcript_lines.text: Perfect! Let's also cut our session from two hours to forty focused minutes so we don't burn out before tomorrow's morning class.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 太好了！我们再把复习从两小时缩短到专注的四十分钟吧，这样明天早课前不会精疲力竭。

transcript_lines.speaker: Leo
transcript_lines.text: Agreed. Twenty minutes for replaying missed lines, and twenty for checking vocabulary errors.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 同意。二十分钟用来回听漏掉的句子，二十分钟核对错词。

questions.stem: Why did Leo decide not to meet at the student cafe?
options: Background noise made it hard to hear key listening cues.
The cafe closes at six thirty on weekdays.
Coffee prices doubled after the midterm week.
Maya preferred to study alone in her dormitory.
questions.answer: Background noise made it hard to hear key listening cues.

evidence_anchor.text_span: Actually, I had to cancel that spot. Last time the espresso machine made it almost impossible to hear the speaker's transitions.

questions.key_evidence_line: Last time the espresso machine made it almost impossible to hear the speaker's transitions.
questions.explanation_zh: Leo 用 Actually 引出取消原计划的原因：意式咖啡机噪音让人几乎听不清说话人的转折词（speaker's transitions），对应选项中的 background noise。
distractor_reasons: 正确：espresso machine 噪音导致几乎听不清转折词，同义替换为 background noise。
错误：六点半后开放且空着的是院系休息室，不是咖啡馆关门。
错误：对话未提及咖啡价格。
错误：两人仍打算一起学习，并未各自回宿舍。

questions.stem: Where will Maya and Leo actually meet tonight?
options: In a third-floor library study room.
At the student cafe near the gate.
questions.answer: In Leo's department lounge.

evidence_anchor.text_span: I checked earlier, and all library rooms are booked for final projects. Good thing is, my department lounge stays open and empty after six thirty.

questions.key_evidence_line: Good thing is, my department lounge stays open and empty after six thirty.
questions.explanation_zh: 对话中先排除咖啡馆，再排除被订满的图书馆研讨室（all library rooms are booked），最后确定地点为 Leo 的院系休息室（department lounge）。
distractor_reasons: 正确：图书馆订满后，Leo 提出去院系休息室并获 Maya 同意。
错误：图书馆三楼研讨室已被期末项目全部订满，属于被否定的提议。
错误：学生咖啡馆已被 Leo 取消。
错误：文中未提到空教室。

questions.stem: How long will their evening review session last?
questions.answer: Forty minutes.

evidence_anchor.text_span: Perfect! Let's also cut our session from two hours to forty focused minutes so we don't burn out before tomorrow's morning class.

questions.key_evidence_line: Let's also cut our session from two hours to forty focused minutes so we don't burn out before tomorrow's morning class.
questions.explanation_zh: 注意数字修正信号 cut from two hours to forty focused minutes；后面 Leo 说的 twenty + twenty 恰好合计 40 分钟。
distractor_reasons: 正确：Maya 提议将两小时缩减到专注的四十分钟，Leo 表示同意。
错误：two hours 是被削减掉的原时长，属于数字陷阱。
错误：twenty minutes 只是其中一半（回听漏句 20 分钟 + 核对错词 20 分钟）。
错误：文中未出现九十分钟。

listening_cases.title: Public Libraries as Community Learning Hubs
listening_cases.title_zh: 短文听力：公共图书馆如何转型为社区学习中心

transcript_lines.speaker: Narrator
transcript_lines.text: Ten years ago, some analysts predicted that affordable smartphones and e-books would make neighborhood libraries unnecessary.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 十年前，一些分析人士曾预测平价智能手机和电子书会让社区图书馆失去存在必要。

transcript_lines.speaker: Narrator
transcript_lines.text: Yet recent attendance reports show that many local branches are busier than ever, especially on weekday evenings.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 然而最近的到馆人数报告显示，许多社区分馆比以往任何时候都更热闹，尤其是在工作日傍晚。

transcript_lines.speaker: Narrator
transcript_lines.text: Instead of functioning purely as silent book warehouses, libraries have added shared workstations, language conversation clubs, and free career-skills workshops.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 图书馆不再仅仅作为安静的藏书仓库运转，而是增设了共享工位、语言交流角以及免费的职业技能工作坊。

transcript_lines.speaker: Narrator
transcript_lines.text: Still, librarians warn that expanding digital services requires steady public funding to train staff and maintain reliable equipment.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 不过，馆员们提醒说，拓展数字服务需要稳定的公共经费来培训员工并维护可靠设备。

transcript_lines.speaker: Narrator
transcript_lines.text: When properly supported, these spaces bridge the gap between solo online study and face-to-face community support.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 只要得到恰当支持，这些空间就能在独自线上学习与面对面社区互助之间架起桥梁。

questions.stem: What happened to neighborhood libraries compared with analysts' predictions ten years ago?
options: Many local branches have actually become busier than before.
Most branches closed after smartphones became affordable.
Visitors stopped coming on weekday evenings.
Libraries removed all printed books to save space.
questions.answer: Many local branches have actually become busier than before.

evidence_anchor.text_span: Yet recent attendance reports show that many local branches are busier than ever, especially on weekday evenings.

questions.key_evidence_line: Yet recent attendance reports show that many local branches are busier than ever, especially on weekday evenings.
questions.explanation_zh: 第1句给出十年前的悲观预测，第2句立即用 Yet 引出实际反差：many local branches are busier than ever。
distractor_reasons: 正确：Yet 后明确指出许多分馆比以往更忙。
错误：这是十年前部分分析人士的误判，并非事实。
错误：原文强调工作日傍晚尤其热闹（especially on weekday evenings），正相反。
错误：原文未提及移除所有纸质书。

questions.stem: Which new service is mentioned as helping libraries transform?
options: Shared workstations and free career-skills workshops.
Overnight sleeping pods for exam candidates.
Paid private tutoring for elementary students.
Commercial coffee chains inside every reading room.
questions.answer: Shared workstations and free career-skills workshops.

evidence_anchor.text_span: Instead of functioning purely as silent book warehouses, libraries have added shared workstations, language conversation clubs, and free career-skills workshops.

questions.key_evidence_line: libraries have added shared workstations, language conversation clubs, and free career-skills workshops.
questions.explanation_zh: 第3句列举了图书馆新增的三项服务：shared workstations、language conversation clubs 和 free career-skills workshops。
distractor_reasons: 正确：直接对应第3句提到的共享工位与免费职业技能工作坊。
错误：文中未提及过夜休息舱。
错误：原文明确是免费的职业技能工作坊，而非小学生收费私教。
错误：文中未提及商业连锁咖啡。

questions.stem: What concern do librarians raise about expanding digital services?
options: It needs steady public funding for staff training and equipment.
Older residents refuse to attend language clubs.
Printed newspapers are too expensive to recycle.
Online learners are forbidden from using shared desks.
questions.answer: It needs steady public funding for staff training and equipment.

evidence_anchor.text_span: Still, librarians warn that expanding digital services requires steady public funding to train staff and maintain reliable equipment.

questions.key_evidence_line: Still, librarians warn that expanding digital services requires steady public funding to train staff and maintain reliable equipment.
questions.explanation_zh: 注意转折词 Still 后面的警示（warn）：拓展数字服务需要稳定的公共经费（steady public funding）来培训员工和维护设备。
distractor_reasons: 正确：完全匹配第4句中馆员的担忧内容。
错误：文中未提及年长居民拒绝参加语言角。
错误：文中未讨论纸质报纸回收成本。
错误：第5句提到图书馆恰恰是连接线上自学和社区互助的桥梁，并非禁止使用。

listening_cases.title: Night-Market Solar Canopy Pilot
listening_cases.title_zh: 短新闻：城市夜市太阳能遮阳棚试点

transcript_lines.speaker: News Anchor
transcript_lines.text: City energy officials announced on Tuesday that the riverside night market has replaced noisy fuel generators with overhead solar canopies.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 市能源官员周二宣布，河滨夜市已用高架太阳能遮阳棚取代了嘈杂的燃油发电机。

transcript_lines.speaker: News Anchor
transcript_lines.text: The translucent panels shade daytime pedestrians while storing enough battery power to light sixty food stalls after sunset.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 半透明光伏板在白天为行人遮阳，同时储存足够的电池电力，在日落后照亮六十个小吃摊位。

transcript_lines.speaker: News Anchor
transcript_lines.text: Vendors initially worried that installation fees would raise monthly stall rents.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 摊主们最初担心安装费用会推高每月的摊位租金。

transcript_lines.speaker: News Anchor
transcript_lines.text: Instead, a municipal green grant covered hardware costs, cutting each vendor's evening electricity bill by roughly thirty-five percent.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 相反，市政绿色专项补助承担了硬件费用，使每位摊主每晚的电费降低了约百分之三十五。

questions.stem: What double benefit do the translucent overhead panels provide?
options: They shade daytime walkers and store power for evening food stalls.
They block rain completely and heat indoor restaurants.
They charge electric buses parked along the riverbank.
They lower rent prices for nearby apartment buildings.
questions.answer: They shade daytime walkers and store power for evening food stalls.

evidence_anchor.text_span: The translucent panels shade daytime pedestrians while storing enough battery power to light sixty food stalls after sunset.

questions.key_evidence_line: The translucent panels shade daytime pedestrians while storing enough battery power to light sixty food stalls after sunset.
questions.explanation_zh: 第2句使用 while 并列结构给出双重功能：白天为行人遮阳（shade daytime pedestrians），同时蓄电在日落后照明60个摊位（pedestrians 同义替换为 walkers）。
distractor_reasons: 正确：直接对应第2句白天遮阳与夜间为摊位供电的双重作用。
错误：原文未提及为室内餐厅供暖。
错误：文中未涉及为电动公交充电。
错误：公寓房租与原文无关。

questions.stem: How did the solar canopy project affect food vendors financially?
options: A city grant paid for installation, and vendors saved about 35% on power bills.
Vendors paid double rent during the first six months.
Stall owners had to buy their own replacement batteries.
Night market operating hours were cut by thirty-five percent.
questions.answer: A city grant paid for installation, and vendors saved about 35% on power bills.

evidence_anchor.text_span: Instead, a municipal green grant covered hardware costs, cutting each vendor's evening electricity bill by roughly thirty-five percent.

questions.key_evidence_line: Instead, a municipal green grant covered hardware costs, cutting each vendor's evening electricity bill by roughly thirty-five percent.
questions.explanation_zh: 第3句提到摊主最初担心涨租，第4句用 Instead 转折说明实际情况：市政绿色补贴承担硬件成本，每位摊主电费降低约 35%。
distractor_reasons: 正确：municipal green grant 对应 city grant，cutting... electricity bill by roughly thirty-five percent 对应 saved about 35%。
错误：涨租只是摊主最初的担忧（worried），并未发生。
错误：硬件费用由市政补贴承担，摊主无需自费购置。
错误：35% 是电费降幅，不是营业时间缩短（数字张冠李戴）。

listening_cases.title: Preparing a Campus Science Poster Together
listening_cases.title_zh: 长对话：合作准备校园科研海报与答辩彩排

transcript_lines.speaker: Claire
transcript_lines.text: Noah, the undergraduate poster fair is this Friday morning, and our charts still have way too much tiny text.
transcript_lines.text_zh: Noah，本科生科研海报展这周五早上就要开始了，但我们的图表里小字还是太多。

transcript_lines.speaker: Noah
transcript_lines.text: You're right. Dr. Lin advised keeping only three key takeaways on the board so visitors can grasp our main finding in under thirty seconds.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 你说得对。林老师建议展板上只保留三条核心结论，这样参观者在三十秒内就能看懂我们的主要发现。

transcript_lines.speaker: Claire
transcript_lines.text: Let's move the detailed data tables to a printed QR code handout instead. Should we print the poster at the campus print shop tomorrow afternoon?
transcript_lines.text_zh: 那我们把详细数据表放到可扫码查看的纸质资料里吧。明天下午去校内打印店印海报怎么样？

transcript_lines.speaker: Noah
transcript_lines.text: Better not wait until tomorrow afternoon. The print shop closes early on Wednesdays for equipment calibration, so we should upload the file before eleven tonight.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 最好别等到明天下午。打印店周三会因为设备校准提前关门，所以我们得在今晚十一点前上传文件。

transcript_lines.speaker: Claire
transcript_lines.text: Good catch! Let's trim the layout right after dinner, submit it by ten, and practice a two-minute spoken summary together tomorrow morning.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 幸亏你想到了！我们晚饭后马上精简排版，十点前提交，明天上午一起练习两分钟口头介绍。

questions.stem: What did Dr. Lin suggest regarding the science poster?
options: Limiting the board to three main takeaways for quick understanding.
Adding larger data tables to every corner of the poster.
Extending the poster presentation speech to ten minutes.
Moving the exhibition from Friday morning to Wednesday.
questions.answer: Limiting the board to three main takeaways for quick understanding.

evidence_anchor.text_span: Dr. Lin advised keeping only three key takeaways on the board so visitors can grasp our main finding in under thirty seconds.

questions.key_evidence_line: Dr. Lin advised keeping only three key takeaways on the board so visitors can grasp our main finding in under thirty seconds.
questions.explanation_zh: Noah 转述林老师的建议：只在展板保留三条核心结论（three key takeaways），以便参观者在 30 秒内看懂主要发现。
distractor_reasons: 正确：直接对应第2句中林老师“只留三条核心结论”的建议。
错误：与原话相反，两人正要把冗长数据表移到扫码传单中。
错误：第5句提到练习两分钟（two-minute）口头简介，并非林老师建议十分钟。
错误：海报展仍在周五上午，周三只是打印店提前关门。

questions.stem: Why can't they wait until tomorrow afternoon to print the poster?
options: The campus print shop closes early on Wednesdays for equipment calibration.
Dr. Lin needs to take the printed poster to another city.
The campus network blocks file uploads after noon.
Printing fees double on Wednesday afternoons.
questions.answer: The campus print shop closes early on Wednesdays for equipment calibration.

evidence_anchor.text_span: Better not wait until tomorrow afternoon. The print shop closes early on Wednesdays for equipment calibration, so we should upload the file before eleven tonight.

questions.key_evidence_line: The print shop closes early on Wednesdays for equipment calibration, so we should upload the file before eleven tonight.
questions.explanation_zh: Noah 否定了明天下午去打印的提议，解释原因是打印店每周三因设备校准提前关门（closes early on Wednesdays for equipment calibration）。
distractor_reasons: 正确：与第4句给出原因完全吻合。
错误：文中未提及林老师带走海报。
错误：校园网限制上传属于无中生有。
错误：未提及周三打印费用翻倍。

questions.stem: What will Claire and Noah do tomorrow morning?
options: Rehearse a two-minute spoken summary together.
Collect new laboratory data for the charts.
Hand out QR code flyers outside the library.
Ask Dr. Lin to redesign the poster layout.
questions.answer: Rehearse a two-minute spoken summary together.

evidence_anchor.text_span: Good catch! Let's trim the layout right after dinner, submit it by ten, and practice a two-minute spoken summary together tomorrow morning.

questions.key_evidence_line: practice a two-minute spoken summary together tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation_zh: 第5句区分了今晚与明早的安排：今晚精简排版并在十点前提交，明天上午（tomorrow morning）一起练习两分钟口头简介（rehearse 同义替换 practice）。
distractor_reasons: 正确：rehearse 同义替换 practice，直接对应 tomorrow morning 的计划。
错误：文中未提重新采集实验数据。
错误：二维码资料是周五展会上供参观者查看，不是明早在图书馆外发放。
错误：两人自己修改排版，并非请林老师重画。

listening_cases.title: Active Recall Versus Passive Highlighting
listening_cases.title_zh: 短文听力：主动回忆为何比反复划重点更有效

transcript_lines.speaker: Narrator
transcript_lines.text: When preparing for university exams, many students cover textbook pages in bright yellow ink and reread the same chapter three times.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 备战大学考试时，许多学生会把教材用荧光笔涂满明黄色，并把同一章重读三遍。

transcript_lines.speaker: Narrator
transcript_lines.text: Although rereading feels smooth and reassuring, educational psychologists warn that familiarity often tricks the brain into believing it has mastered the material.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 尽管重读感觉流畅又让人安心，教育心理学家提醒说，熟悉感常常会欺骗大脑，让人误以为已经掌握了内容。

transcript_lines.speaker: Narrator
transcript_lines.text: By contrast, closing the book and writing down what you remember—a method called active recall—feels harder at first because gaps appear immediately.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 相比之下，合上书把记住的内容写出来——即所谓主动回忆法——起初感觉更吃力，因为知识漏洞会立刻暴露出来。

transcript_lines.speaker: Narrator
transcript_lines.text: In controlled classroom studies, learners who spent half their study time self-testing remembered significantly more details a week later than peers who only reread notes.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 在对照课堂研究中，把一半学习时间用于自测的学生，一周后记住的细节显著多于只重读笔记的同伴。

questions.stem: What risk do educational psychologists point out about rereading highlighted textbooks?
options: Familiarity can create a false impression of real mastery.
Yellow ink makes small print harder to read under lamps.
Students spend too little time copying textbook diagrams.
Teachers forbid using highlighters during open-book tests.
questions.answer: Familiarity can create a false impression of real mastery.

evidence_anchor.text_span: Although rereading feels smooth and reassuring, educational psychologists warn that familiarity often tricks the brain into believing it has mastered the material.

questions.key_evidence_line: familiarity often tricks the brain into believing it has mastered the material.
questions.explanation_zh: 第2句用 Although 让步后提出核心警告：熟悉感往往会欺骗大脑（tricks the brain into believing），形成“已经掌握”的假象。
distractor_reasons: 正确：false impression of mastery 精准同义转述 tricks the brain into believing it has mastered。
错误：文章未讨论荧光笔颜色对视力的影响。
错误：文中未提及抄写课本图表。
错误：文中未提及开卷考试规则。

questions.stem: Why does active recall feel more difficult at first?
options: It immediately exposes gaps in what the learner remembers.
It requires memorizing every page number in order.
It doubles the number of textbook chapters to read.
It prevents students from checking notes afterward.
questions.answer: It immediately exposes gaps in what the learner remembers.

evidence_anchor.text_span: By contrast, closing the book and writing down what you remember—a method called active recall—feels harder at first because gaps appear immediately.

questions.key_evidence_line: feels harder at first because gaps appear immediately.
questions.explanation_zh: 第3句因果连接词 because 清晰交代原因：因为知识漏洞会立即显现（gaps appear immediately）。
distractor_reasons: 正确：exposes gaps 同义替换原文 gaps appear immediately。
错误：文中未要求背诵页码。
错误：并未增加教材章节数量。
错误：自测后当然可以核对笔记，文中未禁止。

questions.stem: What did controlled classroom studies show one week later?
options: Students who practiced self-testing retained noticeably more details.
Rereading notes three times produced higher test scores.
Both study groups forgot everything within seven days.
Highlighting worked best when paired with loud music.
questions.answer: Students who practiced self-testing retained noticeably more details.

evidence_anchor.text_span: In controlled classroom studies, learners who spent half their study time self-testing remembered significantly more details a week later than peers who only reread notes.

questions.key_evidence_line: learners who spent half their study time self-testing remembered significantly more details a week later than peers who only reread notes.
questions.explanation_zh: 第4句实验结论表明：花一半时间自测（self-testing）的学生在一周后记住的细节明显多于仅重读笔记的同伴。
distractor_reasons: 正确：retained noticeably more details 同义替换 remembered significantly more details。
错误：结果与重读笔记占优相反。
错误：并非全部遗忘，自测组保持率显著更高。
错误：文中未提及音乐。

listening_cases.title: AI Writing Assistant Pilot for Freshman Composition
listening_cases.title_zh: 短新闻：高校试点 AI 写作辅助工具提升新生论文逻辑

transcript_lines.speaker: News Anchor
transcript_lines.text: Oakridge University announced on Wednesday that all first-year composition classes will pilot an automated writing feedback tool this fall.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 橡树岭大学周三宣布，今年秋季所有大一写作课程将试点使用一款自动写作反馈工具。

transcript_lines.speaker: News Anchor
transcript_lines.text: Rather than scoring essays or replacing human instructors, the software only flags missing citations and repetitive phrasing before students meet their tutors.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 该软件既不给文章打分，也不取代真人教师，而是在学生见辅导老师之前，只标记遗漏的引用和重复措辞。

transcript_lines.speaker: News Anchor
transcript_lines.text: Writing center directors said the change lets tutors spend nearly twice as much conference time discussing argument logic instead of comma errors.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 写作中心负责人表示，这一变化让辅导老师在面谈中几乎能花两倍的时间讨论论证逻辑，而不是纠结逗号错误。

transcript_lines.speaker: News Anchor
transcript_lines.text: The university will survey participating students in December before deciding whether to expand the program to senior seminars.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 校方将在十二月对参与学生进行问卷调查，随后再决定是否把该项目推广至高年级研讨课。

questions.stem: What does the new AI writing tool actually do for first-year students?
options: It assigns final letter grades to freshman essays automatically.
It highlights missing references and repeated expressions before tutoring.
It writes complete opening paragraphs for students in senior seminars.
It replaces human writing instructors during midterm conferences.
questions.answer: It highlights missing references and repeated expressions before tutoring.

evidence_anchor.text_span: Rather than scoring essays or replacing human instructors, the software only flags missing citations and repetitive phrasing before students meet their tutors.

questions.key_evidence_line: the software only flags missing citations and repetitive phrasing before students meet their tutors.
questions.explanation_zh: 新闻第2句使用 Rather than 排除“打分”和“取代教师”，随后用 only 精准限定软件功能：标记遗漏的引用（missing citations -> missing references）和重复表达（repetitive phrasing -> repeated expressions）。
distractor_reasons: 错误：第2句明确指出 Rather than scoring essays，软件并不打分。
正确：highlights missing references and repeated expressions 同义转述 flags missing citations and repetitive phrasing。
错误：高年级研讨课（senior seminars）只是12月调研后考虑是否推广的对象，软件也不代写段落。
错误：原文明确表示并不取代真人教师（replacing human instructors 被否定）。

questions.stem: How does the pilot program benefit human writing tutors?
options: They can devote far more meeting time to students' reasoning and logic.
They no longer need to hold face-to-face meetings in the fall.
They receive double pay for reviewing senior seminar papers.
They spend extra hours correcting basic punctuation rules.
questions.answer: They can devote far more meeting time to students' reasoning and logic.

evidence_anchor.text_span: Writing center directors said the change lets tutors spend nearly twice as much conference time discussing argument logic instead of comma errors.

questions.key_evidence_line: the change lets tutors spend nearly twice as much conference time discussing argument logic instead of comma errors.
questions.explanation_zh: 第3句说明该工具带来的积极效果：辅导老师可以把近两倍的面谈时间用于探讨论证逻辑（argument logic），而不必花在逗号等标点错误上。
distractor_reasons: 正确：devote far more meeting time to students' reasoning and logic 准确对应 spend nearly twice as much conference time discussing argument logic。
错误：学生依然要与辅导老师面谈（meet their tutors / conference time）。
错误：文中提到的是两倍的讨论时间（twice as much conference time），不是双倍薪水。
错误：与原话相反，老师正是借此减少了处理逗号错误的时间。

listening_cases.title: Subway Platform Real-Time Crowding Displays
listening_cases.title_zh: 短新闻：城市地铁站台增设车厢实时拥挤度显示屏

transcript_lines.speaker: News Anchor
transcript_lines.text: Commuters on the city's busy Blue Line can now check how crowded each subway car is before the train even enters the station.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 乘坐本市繁忙蓝线地铁的通勤者，如今在列车尚未进站前就能查看每节车厢的拥挤程度。

transcript_lines.speaker: News Anchor
transcript_lines.text: New overhead screens use weight sensors built into train axles rather than facial cameras, showing green, yellow, or red icons for every car.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 新建的上方显示屏采用列车车轴内置的重量传感器而非人脸摄像头，为每节车厢显示绿、黄或红三种图标。

transcript_lines.speaker: News Anchor
transcript_lines.text: Transit managers said passengers quickly spread out toward greener cars near both ends of the platform instead of squeezing near center escalators.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 公交管理部门称，乘客很快不再挤在中部扶梯附近，而是分散前往站台两端显示绿色的空余车厢。

transcript_lines.speaker: News Anchor
transcript_lines.text: During the three-month trial, average door-closing delays during morning peak hours fell by twenty-two percent.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 在为期三个月的试运行期间，早高峰列车关门的平均延误时间下降了百分之二十二。

questions.stem: How does the new display system measure crowding inside each subway car?
options: By counting ticket scans at station turnstiles.
By using facial recognition cameras above the doors.
By reading data from weight sensors in train axles.
By asking conductors to send text updates at each stop.
questions.answer: By reading data from weight sensors in train axles.

evidence_anchor.text_span: New overhead screens use weight sensors built into train axles rather than facial cameras, showing green, yellow, or red icons for every car.

questions.key_evidence_line: New overhead screens use weight sensors built into train axles rather than facial cameras
questions.explanation_zh: 第2句明确对比了技术手段：use weight sensors built into train axles rather than facial cameras（使用列车车轴重量传感器，而不是人脸摄像头）。
distractor_reasons: 错误：闸机刷卡数据无法精确反映具体哪节车厢的实时人数，文中未提。
错误：原文用 rather than facial cameras 明确排除了摄像头方案。
正确：直接对应 weight sensors built into train axles。
错误：文中未提及列车员发短信报告。

questions.stem: What measurable result was recorded during the three-month trial?
options: Morning peak door-closing delays dropped by 22 percent.
Ticket prices on the Blue Line fell by 22 percent.
Passengers stopped using the center escalators altogether.
Twenty-two additional trains were added to the schedule.
questions.answer: Morning peak door-closing delays dropped by 22 percent.

evidence_anchor.text_span: During the three-month trial, average door-closing delays during morning peak hours fell by twenty-two percent.

questions.key_evidence_line: average door-closing delays during morning peak hours fell by twenty-two percent.
questions.explanation_zh: 第4句给出试运行量化结果：早高峰平均关门延误下降了 22%（fell by twenty-two percent）。
distractor_reasons: 正确：dropped by 22 percent 准确对应 fell by twenty-two percent。
错误：22% 是关门延误降幅，不是票价降幅，属于数字张冠李戴。
错误：乘客只是分散走向两端较空的车厢，并非完全停用中部扶梯。
错误：22 是百分比，不是新增列车数量。

listening_cases.title: Harbor Bubble Curtains Protect Migrating Whales
listening_cases.title_zh: 短新闻：港口启用水下气泡幕墙保护迁徙鲸鱼免受施工噪音干扰

transcript_lines.speaker: News Anchor
transcript_lines.text: Marine engineers at Bayport Harbor have begun using walls of rising air bubbles to shield migrating whales from underwater construction noise.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 海湾港的海洋工程师开始利用上升气泡构成的屏障，保护迁徙鲸鱼免受水下施工噪音的影响。

transcript_lines.speaker: News Anchor
transcript_lines.text: Environmental groups had originally urged the port to halt dock repairs completely for four months every spring.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 环保团体最初曾敦促港口每年春季全面暂停码头维修四个月。

transcript_lines.speaker: News Anchor
transcript_lines.text: However, port officials feared that pausing repairs would delay essential flood-wall upgrades before summer storms.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 然而，港口官员担心暂停施工会耽误夏季风暴来临前的关键防洪堤升级工程。

transcript_lines.speaker: News Anchor
transcript_lines.text: By pumping air through perforated seabed pipes, the bubble curtain breaks up sound waves, cutting measured noise levels by more than half.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 通过向海底带孔管道泵入空气，气泡幕墙打散了声波，使实测噪音水平降低了一半以上。

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the air-bubble walls installed at Bayport Harbor?
options: To guide cargo ships safely into foggy docks.
To clear floating plastic waste out of shipping lanes.
To protect migrating whales from loud construction sounds.
To cool shallow coastal water during summer storms.
questions.answer: To protect migrating whales from loud construction sounds.

evidence_anchor.text_span: Marine engineers at Bayport Harbor have begun using walls of rising air bubbles to shield migrating whales from underwater construction noise.

questions.key_evidence_line: using walls of rising air bubbles to shield migrating whales from underwater construction noise.
questions.explanation_zh: 新闻导语第1句直接点明工程目的：to shield migrating whales from underwater construction noise（保护迁徙鲸鱼免受水下施工噪音伤害），shield 同义替换为 protect。
distractor_reasons: 错误：原文未提及引导货船穿越大雾。
错误：未提及清理塑料垃圾。
正确：protect 同义替换 shield，construction sounds 对应 construction noise。
错误：降温海水属于无中生有。

questions.stem: Why did port officials reject the proposal to stop dock repairs every spring?
options: Halting work could postpone vital flood-wall upgrades before summer storms.
Repair crews had already signed contracts to work in another harbor.
Whales rarely swim near Bayport Harbor during spring months.
Environmental groups withdrew their proposal after one week.
questions.answer: Halting work could postpone vital flood-wall upgrades before summer storms.

evidence_anchor.text_span: However, port officials feared that pausing repairs would delay essential flood-wall upgrades before summer storms.

questions.key_evidence_line: However, port officials feared that pausing repairs would delay essential flood-wall upgrades before summer storms.
questions.explanation_zh: 第2句引出环保团体全面停工四个月的提议，第3句用 However 转折给出港方担忧：停工会推迟夏季风暴前至关重要的防洪堤升级（essential flood-wall upgrades）。
distractor_reasons: 正确：postpone vital flood-wall upgrades 同义替换 delay essential flood-wall upgrades。
错误：文中未提及维修队去其他港口签合同。
错误：春季正是鲸鱼迁徙期，与原文背景相悖。
错误：环保团体并未撤回提议，而是改用了折中方案。

questions.stem: What effect does the bubble curtain have on underwater noise?
options: It eliminates all shipping noise across the entire ocean.
It reduces measured noise levels by over fifty percent.
It doubles the speed of sound waves near the seabed.
It forces whales to swim four months earlier than usual.
questions.answer: It reduces measured noise levels by over fifty percent.

evidence_anchor.text_span: By pumping air through perforated seabed pipes, the bubble curtain breaks up sound waves, cutting measured noise levels by more than half.

questions.key_evidence_line: cutting measured noise levels by more than half.
questions.explanation_zh: 第4句说明降噪效果：cutting measured noise levels by more than half（将实测噪音降低一半以上），more than half 等价于 over fifty percent。
distractor_reasons: 错误：原文是降低一半以上，并非彻底消除整个海洋的所有航运噪音（绝对化陷阱）。
正确：over fifty percent 精准对应 more than half。
错误：气泡幕墙的作用是打散声波（breaks up sound waves），不是加倍声速。
错误：four months 是环保组织最初提议停工的时长，与鲸鱼提前游动无关。

listening_cases.title: Apartment Complex Shared Solar Microgrid
listening_cases.title_zh: 短新闻：居民公寓楼共建屋顶太阳能共享微电网

transcript_lines.speaker: News Anchor
transcript_lines.text: One hundred and twenty households in a hillside apartment complex have connected their rooftop solar panels into a single neighborhood microgrid.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 一座山坡公寓楼群的一百二十户居民将屋顶太阳能电池板接入了同一个社区微电网。

transcript_lines.speaker: News Anchor
transcript_lines.text: Previously, most families left for work during peak sunlight hours, allowing surplus electricity to go unused.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 过去，多数家庭在阳光最充足的时段外出上班，导致富余电力白白浪费。

transcript_lines.speaker: News Anchor
transcript_lines.text: Now, a shared basement battery stores midday energy to power elevators at night and sells extra electricity to nearby ground-floor bakeries and clinics.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 如今，地下室共享电池组储存正午电能，供夜间电梯运行，并将多余电力出售给附近一楼的面包店和诊所。

transcript_lines.speaker: News Anchor
transcript_lines.text: During last month's heatwave blackout, the building stayed lit for fourteen hours while surrounding blocks lost air conditioning.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 在上个月热浪引发的停电期间，周边街区空调停转，而该楼群持续正常供电达十四小时。

questions.stem: Why was solar power often wasted before the microgrid was built?
options: Most residents were away at work during peak midday sunshine.
The hillside blocked sunlight from reaching the apartment roofs.
Basement batteries overheated whenever elevators were running.
Local clinics refused to purchase clean electricity from neighbors.
questions.answer: Most residents were away at work during peak midday sunshine.

evidence_anchor.text_span: Previously, most families left for work during peak sunlight hours, allowing surplus electricity to go unused.

questions.key_evidence_line: most families left for work during peak sunlight hours, allowing surplus electricity to go unused.
questions.explanation_zh: 第2句用 Previously 交代改造前的问题：在光照最强时段多数家庭出门上班（left for work during peak sunlight hours），多余电力未能利用。
distractor_reasons: 正确：away at work during peak midday sunshine 同义转述 left for work during peak sunlight hours。
错误：山坡并未遮挡阳光，相反此前就能发电，只是没人用。
错误：共享电池是微电网新建项目（Now），并非旧问题。
错误：诊所现在正是购电方之一。

questions.stem: How is the stored midday energy used under the new system?
options: To charge electric delivery vans parked outside the apartments.
To run building elevators at night and supply nearby street-level shops.
To heat swimming pools for one hundred and twenty residents.
To replace backup generators at downtown hospitals.
questions.answer: To run building elevators at night and supply nearby street-level shops.

evidence_anchor.text_span: Now, a shared basement battery stores midday energy to power elevators at night and sells extra electricity to nearby ground-floor bakeries and clinics.

questions.key_evidence_line: stores midday energy to power elevators at night and sells extra electricity to nearby ground-floor bakeries and clinics.
questions.explanation_zh: 第3句给出共享电池的两个去向：夜间驱动电梯（power elevators at night），以及把余电卖给一楼的面包店和诊所（ground-floor bakeries and clinics -> nearby street-level shops）。
distractor_reasons: 错误：文中未提电动货车充电。
正确：street-level shops 概括了 ground-floor bakeries and clinics，与夜间电梯供电完全吻合。
错误：120 是住户总数，文中未提游泳池加热。
错误：是一楼诊所（clinics），不是市中心医院。

questions.stem: What did last month's heatwave blackout demonstrate about the microgrid?
options: It can keep a building supplied with electricity when the wider grid fails.
It only works smoothly during cool spring and autumn afternoons.
It forces residents to turn off all lights for fourteen hours a day.
It cannot support air conditioning in surrounding city blocks.
questions.answer: It can keep a building supplied with electricity when the wider grid fails.

evidence_anchor.text_span: During last month's heatwave blackout, the building stayed lit for fourteen hours while surrounding blocks lost air conditioning.

questions.key_evidence_line: During last month's heatwave blackout, the building stayed lit for fourteen hours while surrounding blocks lost air conditioning.
questions.explanation_zh: 第4句通过对比说明停电时的韧性：周边街区断电失去空调，该公寓楼靠微电网仍稳定供电 14 小时（stayed lit for fourteen hours）。
distractor_reasons: 正确：准确概括微电网在大电网停电时的独立供电能力。
错误：此次检验恰好发生在酷热停电期（heatwave blackout），而非凉爽季节。
错误：是持续亮灯 14 小时，不是关灯 14 小时。
错误：微电网本就是为本公寓楼群供电，而非为周边街区供电。

listening_cases.title: Regional Archive Volunteer Map Digitization
listening_cases.title_zh: 短新闻：地方档案馆招募大学生志愿者数字化历史地图

transcript_lines.speaker: News Anchor
transcript_lines.text: For decades, over two thousand fragile nineteenth-century street maps sat inside locked drawers at the Regional History Archive.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 数十年来，两千余张脆弱的十九世纪街道地图一直被锁在地方历史档案馆的抽屉里。

transcript_lines.speaker: News Anchor
transcript_lines.text: Staff feared that pressing the folded paper onto standard flatbed scanners would tear faded ink lines and brittle edges.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 工作人员担心把折叠纸张压在普通平板扫描仪上会撕裂褪色的墨线和发脆的纸边。

transcript_lines.speaker: News Anchor
transcript_lines.text: Last spring, archivists partnered with local college students, training sixty volunteers to use non-contact overhead cameras instead.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 去年春天，档案馆员与当地大学生合作，培训六十名志愿者改用非接触式高拍相机进行拍摄。

transcript_lines.speaker: News Anchor
transcript_lines.text: So far, fourteen hundred maps have been uploaded to a free searchable website used by urban planners and high-school teachers.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 截至目前，已有约一千四百张地图上传至一个免费可检索网站，供城市规划师和中学教师使用。

questions.stem: Why didn't archive staff use ordinary flatbed scanners on the old maps?
options: Flatbed scanners were too small for modern city maps.
Pressing the fragile paper could damage brittle edges and ink.
The archive could not afford electricity for scanning equipment.
College volunteers preferred drawing copies by hand.
questions.answer: Pressing the fragile paper could damage brittle edges and ink.

evidence_anchor.text_span: Staff feared that pressing the folded paper onto standard flatbed scanners would tear faded ink lines and brittle edges.

questions.key_evidence_line: pressing the folded paper onto standard flatbed scanners would tear faded ink lines and brittle edges.
questions.explanation_zh: 第2句解释不用普通平板扫描仪的原因：压平折叠图纸会撕破（tear）褪色墨线和脆弱纸边（brittle edges）。
distractor_reasons: 错误：担心的是物理压损纸张，并非尺寸放不下现代地图。
正确：damage brittle edges and ink 准确转述 tear faded ink lines and brittle edges。
错误：文中未提电费问题。
错误：志愿者使用的是非接触式高拍相机，不是手绘。

questions.stem: Who helped the archivists photograph the maps last spring?
options: Retired urban planners from nearby cities.
Commercial photographers hired by the city.
questions.answer: Sixty trained local college volunteers.

evidence_anchor.text_span: Last spring, archivists partnered with local college students, training sixty volunteers to use non-contact overhead cameras instead.

questions.key_evidence_line: archivists partnered with local college students, training sixty volunteers to use non-contact overhead cameras instead.
questions.explanation_zh: 第3句明确交代拍摄团队：当地大学生（local college students），共培训了 60 名志愿者。
distractor_reasons: 正确：完全对应 local college students 与 training sixty volunteers。
错误：1,400 是已上传地图数量，中学教师是网站使用者（数字与身份双重错配）。
错误：城市规划师也是网站用户，并非拍摄者。
错误：文中明确是志愿者，并非聘请的商业摄影师。

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the digitized map collection today?
options: All two thousand maps are locked away again after scanning.
Only paying subscribers can view the online archive.
Roughly six hundred maps still remain to be uploaded.
High-school teachers have to visit the archive in person.
questions.answer: Roughly six hundred maps still remain to be uploaded.

evidence_anchor.text_span: So far, fourteen hundred maps have been uploaded to a free searchable website used by urban planners and high-school teachers.

questions.key_evidence_line: So far, fourteen hundred maps have been uploaded to a free searchable website
questions.explanation_zh: 第1句提到共有两千多张（over two thousand）地图，第4句说明目前已上传一千四百张（fourteen hundred），由此推知仍有约六百张（2000 - 1400）尚待上传，这是四级听力常见的数字推理考点。
distractor_reasons: 错误：已上传的 1,400 张在免费可检索网站公开使用，并非全部锁起来。
错误：第4句明确说明是 free searchable website（免费网站）。
正确：结合第1句 over two thousand 与第4句 fourteen hundred uploaded，推算约余 600 张。
错误：教师可通过在线网站直接检索使用，无需亲自到馆。

listening_cases.title: High-School Rooftop Pollinator Gardens
listening_cases.title_zh: 短新闻：中学平顶屋顶改造为蜜蜂传粉花园与生物户外实验室

transcript_lines.speaker: News Anchor
transcript_lines.text: Six public high schools across the metro area have replaced barren gravel roofs with native wildflower beds this year.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 今年，大都会区的六所公立高中将荒芜的碎石屋顶改造成了本土野花花坛。

transcript_lines.speaker: News Anchor
transcript_lines.text: While school boards initially approved the project to teach biology students about declining bee populations, facilities teams noticed an unexpected bonus.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 虽然校董会最初批准该项目是为了向生物课学生讲授蜜蜂数量下降问题，但后勤团队发现了一个意想不到的额外收获。

transcript_lines.speaker: News Anchor
transcript_lines.text: The shallow soil and foliage insulated top-floor classrooms so well that June cooling bills fell by eighteen percent.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 浅层土壤和植被对顶层教室起到了极佳的隔热作用，使六月份的制冷电费下降了百分之十八。

transcript_lines.speaker: News Anchor
transcript_lines.text: Meanwhile, students logged twelve native pollinator species on campus roofs where zero had been spotted the previous spring.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 与此同时，学生们在去年春天还一只未见的校园屋顶上记录到了十二种本土传粉昆虫。

questions.stem: What was the school boards' original reason for approving the rooftop gardens?
options: To grow fresh vegetables for school lunch cafeterias.
To help biology students study shrinking bee populations.
To test waterproof gravel before rebuilding six roofs.
To earn money by selling wildflowers at city markets.
questions.answer: To help biology students study shrinking bee populations.

evidence_anchor.text_span: While school boards initially approved the project to teach biology students about declining bee populations, facilities teams noticed an unexpected bonus.

questions.key_evidence_line: school boards initially approved the project to teach biology students about declining bee populations
questions.explanation_zh: 第2句用 While 引出最初目的（initially approved the project to...）：教生物课学生了解蜜蜂数量减少（declining bee populations -> shrinking bee populations）。
distractor_reasons: 错误：屋顶种植的是本土野花（native wildflower beds），并非食堂蔬菜。
正确：shrinking bee populations 同义替换 declining bee populations。
错误：项目是把碎石屋顶（gravel roofs）替换掉，并非测试碎石。
错误：文中未提卖花创收。

questions.stem: What unexpected benefit did the facilities teams observe?
options: Top-floor cooling costs dropped by 18 percent in June.
The gravel roofs needed no maintenance for twelve years.
Students stopped opening classroom windows during class.
Heating bills fell sharply during winter snowstorms.
questions.answer: Top-floor cooling costs dropped by 18 percent in June.

evidence_anchor.text_span: The shallow soil and foliage insulated top-floor classrooms so well that June cooling bills fell by eighteen percent.

questions.key_evidence_line: insulated top-floor classrooms so well that June cooling bills fell by eighteen percent.
questions.explanation_zh: 第2句末尾提到 unexpected bonus（意外收获），第3句紧接着揭示：土壤和植物为顶层教室隔热，使6月制冷电费下降 18%。
distractor_reasons: 正确：cooling costs dropped by 18 percent 对应 June cooling bills fell by eighteen percent。
错误：12 是记录到的传粉昆虫种类数（twelve native pollinator species），且碎石已被替换。
错误：文中未提学生关窗问题。
错误：原文说的是 6 月制冷费（June cooling bills），不是冬季取暖费。

questions.stem: What change did students record regarding wildlife on the school roofs?
options: Twelve native pollinator species appeared where none were seen before.
Pollinator numbers stayed at zero because of city air pollution.
Only one rare bee species survived the June heatwave.
Six bird species nested inside the biology classrooms.
questions.answer: Twelve native pollinator species appeared where none were seen before.

evidence_anchor.text_span: Meanwhile, students logged twelve native pollinator species on campus roofs where zero had been spotted the previous spring.

questions.key_evidence_line: students logged twelve native pollinator species on campus roofs where zero had been spotted the previous spring.
questions.explanation_zh: 第4句通过前后对比突出生态效果：去年春天一只未见（zero had been spotted），今年记录到 12 种本土传粉昆虫。
distractor_reasons: 正确：精确对应 twelve native pollinator species 与 where zero had been spotted。
错误：数量从 0 增至 12 种，与选项相反。
错误：共 12 种，并非仅 1 种。
错误：文中讨论的是传粉昆虫，未提鸟类在教室筑巢。

listening_cases.title: Signing Up as a Weekend Museum Docent
listening_cases.title_zh: 长对话：申请海事博物馆周末双语志愿讲解员

transcript_lines.speaker: Elena
transcript_lines.text: Marcus, are you still thinking about applying for the weekend volunteer guide program at the Maritime Museum?
transcript_lines.text_zh: Marcus，你还在考虑申请海事博物馆的周末志愿讲解员项目吗？

transcript_lines.speaker: Marcus
transcript_lines.text: Yes, I really want to practice public speaking, though I have to avoid Saturday morning shifts because my chemistry lab meets until noon.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 是的，我很想锻炼公开演讲能力，不过我得避开周六上午的班次，因为我的化学实验课要上到中午十二点。

transcript_lines.speaker: Elena
transcript_lines.text: That's fine. The coordinator told me Sunday afternoon tours need bilingual helpers most anyway, especially for visiting school groups.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 没关系。协调员跟我说周日下午的讲解其实最缺双语帮手，尤其是接待来参观的中小学团队。

transcript_lines.speaker: Marcus
transcript_lines.text: Great! Is it true volunteers have to memorize the entire three-hour history script before the interview?
transcript_lines.text_zh: 太好了！听说志愿者面试前必须背下整整三小时的历史讲解词，是真的吗？

transcript_lines.speaker: Elena
transcript_lines.text: Not at all. For the interview, you just present one five-minute story about a single ship exhibit, and once accepted they cover your subway pass.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 根本不用。面试时你只需要针对一件船模展品讲一个五分钟的小故事，录取后馆方还会报销地铁交通卡。

transcript_lines.speaker: Marcus
transcript_lines.text: That takes off so much pressure. Let's pick our exhibit topics tonight and submit the online forms together tomorrow.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 那压力小多了。我们今晚就选好各自要讲的展品主题，明天一起提交网上申请表吧。

questions.stem: Why can't Marcus take a Saturday morning volunteer shift?
options: He works at a campus bookstore on Saturday mornings.
He has a chemistry lab session that runs until noon.
The museum is closed to school groups until Sunday.
Public buses do not run to the harbor on Saturdays.
questions.answer: He has a chemistry lab session that runs until noon.

evidence_anchor.text_span: Yes, I really want to practice public speaking, though I have to avoid Saturday morning shifts because my chemistry lab meets until noon.

questions.key_evidence_line: I have to avoid Saturday morning shifts because my chemistry lab meets until noon.
questions.explanation_zh: 第2句中 Marcus 用 because 直接交代时间冲突：他的化学实验课要上到中午（chemistry lab meets until noon）。
distractor_reasons: 错误：文中未提及校园书店工作。
正确：与第2句原因完全一致。
错误：对话只说周日下午最缺双语帮手，并未说周六闭馆。
错误：文中提及的是报销地铁卡，并未说周六停运。

questions.stem: When are bilingual volunteers needed most at the Maritime Museum?
questions.answer: On Sunday afternoons.

evidence_anchor.text_span: The coordinator told me Sunday afternoon tours need bilingual helpers most anyway, especially for visiting school groups.

questions.key_evidence_line: Sunday afternoon tours need bilingual helpers most anyway, especially for visiting school groups.
questions.explanation_zh: 第3句 Elena 转述协调员的话：周日下午（Sunday afternoon）的参观团最需要双语志愿者。
distractor_reasons: 正确：直接对应第3句 Sunday afternoon tours need bilingual helpers most。
错误：周六上午是 Marcus 上实验课而要避开的时段。
错误：文中是周末志愿项目，未提及周三晚上。
错误：未提及暑期工作日。

questions.stem: What are applicants actually asked to do during the volunteer interview?
options: Recite a complete three-hour museum history script.
Lead a group of elementary students through five halls.
Pass a written chemistry test before training begins.
Give a five-minute story about one ship exhibit.
questions.answer: Give a five-minute story about one ship exhibit.

evidence_anchor.text_span: Not at all. For the interview, you just present one five-minute story about a single ship exhibit, and once accepted they cover your subway pass.

questions.key_evidence_line: For the interview, you just present one five-minute story about a single ship exhibit
questions.explanation_zh: Marcus 担心要背三小时讲稿，Elena 用 Not at all 否定后给出真实要求：只需针对单个船只展品讲一个五分钟的故事（one five-minute story about a single ship exhibit）。
distractor_reasons: 错误：三小时讲稿是被 Elena 否定的谣言（Not at all）。
错误：带学生逛五个展厅属于无中生有。
错误：化学实验课只是 Marcus 的个人课程，不是面试测试。
正确：精确对应第5句要求。

listening_cases.title: Switching to a Campus Bookstore Part-Time Job
listening_cases.title_zh: 长对话：从深夜咖啡店改换到校园书店兼职以兼顾备考

transcript_lines.speaker: Daniel
transcript_lines.text: Hannah, you looked exhausted in history seminar today. Are those late shifts at the downtown cafe catching up with you?
transcript_lines.text_zh: Hannah，你今天在历史研讨课上看起来精疲力竭。是不是市区咖啡店那些晚班把你累坏了？

transcript_lines.speaker: Hannah
transcript_lines.text: Honestly, yes. Closing the shop at midnight leaves me too wired to fall asleep before two, and my midterm grades are slipping.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 说实话是的。半夜十二点关店后我太亢奋，两点前根本睡不着，期中成绩都下滑了。

transcript_lines.speaker: Daniel
transcript_lines.text: I can't afford to quit working completely either, so why not apply for the campus bookstore desk? They need someone for ten hours a week.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 我也不能完全放弃打工，要不你去申请校园书店的前台岗位吧？他们正好招每周工作十小时的兼职。

transcript_lines.speaker: Hannah
transcript_lines.text: Ten hours sounds manageable, though doesn't it pay a bit less per hour than making specialty drinks?
transcript_lines.text_zh: 十小时听起来还应付得来，不过时薪是不是比做特调饮品少一点？

transcript_lines.speaker: Daniel
transcript_lines.text: Two dollars less per hour, true, but you save twenty minutes of bus fare each way and can review flashcards during quiet morning hours.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 每小时确实少两美元，但你省下了单程二十分钟的公交费和通勤时间，而且早上清闲时还能背单词卡。

transcript_lines.speaker: Hannah
transcript_lines.text: Being able to study on the clock and sleep before midnight makes that trade-off totally worth it. I'll drop off my schedule this afternoon.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 上班空闲时还能学习、半夜前就能睡觉，这个取舍太值了。我今天下午就把空闲时间表交过去。

questions.stem: Why is Hannah struggling with her midterm grades?
options: Midnight cafe shifts prevent her from sleeping until two in the morning.
Her history professor assigned three extra research papers.
She has been working forty hours a week at the campus bookstore.
Buses from downtown stop running before ten at night.
questions.answer: Midnight cafe shifts prevent her from sleeping until two in the morning.

evidence_anchor.text_span: Honestly, yes. Closing the shop at midnight leaves me too wired to fall asleep before two, and my midterm grades are slipping.

questions.key_evidence_line: Closing the shop at midnight leaves me too wired to fall asleep before two, and my midterm grades are slipping.
questions.explanation_zh: 第2句 Hannah 解释成绩下滑的原因：午夜十二点才关店导致神经兴奋（too wired），凌晨两点前睡不着。
distractor_reasons: 正确：直接对应第2句午夜关店与凌晨两点前难入睡导致成绩下滑。
错误：文中未提历史教授加派三篇论文。
错误：校园书店每周仅十小时，且是 Daniel 新推荐的岗位。
错误：文中仅说坐公交单程要二十分钟及公交费，未说十点停运。

questions.stem: What disadvantage of the campus bookstore job does Daniel acknowledge?
options: It pays two dollars less per hour than the cafe job.
It requires working late shifts every Friday night.
