questions.stem: What main advantage of campus rain gardens is emphasized at the end?
options: Smart surface shaping manages variable rain more affordably than buried culverts.
All university libraries should relocate next to natural hillside creeks.
Underground steel pipes always fail within twenty-four hours of squalls.
Dormitory lawn sprinklers work best when paired with deep gravel beds.
questions.answer: Smart surface shaping manages variable rain more affordably than buried culverts.
questions.evidence_text: Even campus budgets come out ahead: native perennials thrive without thirsty lawn sprinklers, proving subtle terrain shaping beats costly underground steel culverts when cities adapt to erratic rainfall.

evidence_anchor.text_span: Even campus budgets come out ahead: native perennials thrive without thirsty lawn sprinklers, proving subtle terrain shaping beats costly underground steel culverts when cities adapt to erratic rainfall.

questions.explanation_zh: 末句点明巧妙的微地形塑造比昂贵的地下钢制暗管更具经济与生态韧性。
distractor_reasons: 正确：精准对应文章最终核心立意。
错误：未讨论图书馆搬迁。
错误：未称钢管24小时必坏，而是建造成本过高且生态效益低。
错误：恰恰无需再依赖高耗水草坪喷灌。

writing_tasks.title: 高级句型改写：用倒装或强调句表达“持续练习的重要性”
writing_tasks.prompt_zh: 将下面的基础简单句改写为更地道、适合四级议论文结尾的表达（建议使用 only by / not only... but also / play a crucial role 等结构）：
writing_tasks.source_text: If students practice listening every day, they can improve their accuracy and feel more confident.
writing_tasks.hint: 可尝试使用：Only by + doing... can students... 或 Consistent daily practice plays a crucial role in...
checklist_points: 保留“每天练习听力”、“提高准确率”和“增强自信”三层完整含义
至少使用一种升级句式（如 Only by 倒装、动名词作主语或 play a crucial role in）
主谓一致与情态动词后动词原形无语法错误（如 can students improve）
writing_tasks.model_answer: Only by practicing listening consistently every day can students boost their accuracy and build lasting confidence.
writing_tasks.analysis_zh: “Only + 介词短语（by doing...）”置于句首时，主句需要部分倒装（can students boost...），这是四级写作阅卷中最稳妥且易得分的句式升级；同时用 boost / build 替换较口语化的 improve / feel。

writing_tasks.title: 高级句型改写：合并因果与让步关系（校园绿色出行）
writing_tasks.prompt_zh: 把两句松散的简单句合并为一句逻辑紧凑的四级高分复合句（建议使用 Although / While 或非谓语分词结构）：
writing_tasks.source_text: Shared bikes are very convenient on campus. However, poor maintenance often forces students to take shuttle buses.
writing_tasks.hint: 注意不要在一个英文句子中同时出现 Although 和 but！
checklist_points: 准确体现“尽管方便，但维护不足仍迫使学生改乘校车”的让步转折关系
避免中文母语负迁移错误：不可同时使用 Although... but...
准确运用 force sb. to do sth. 或 rely on 等高频搭配
writing_tasks.model_answer: Although shared bikes offer great convenience on campus, inadequate maintenance often forces students to fall back on shuttle buses.
writing_tasks.analysis_zh: 用 Although 引导让步状语从句连接前后两句，同时删去 However 避免连词重复；将 very convenient 名词化为 offer great convenience，用 inadequate 替换口语化的 poor，提升书面语质感。

writing_tasks.title: 短段汉译英：城市社区公共图书馆转型
writing_tasks.prompt_zh: 请将下面这段约 60 字的中文短段翻译为通顺准确的英文（四级段落翻译微训练）：
writing_tasks.source_text: 近年来，越来越多的城市公共图书馆不仅提供安静的阅读空间，还定期举办免费的文化讲座和职业技能培训，帮助不同年龄的市民持续学习。
writing_tasks.hint: 参考词汇：public libraries, not only... but also..., hold/organize regularly, career-skills training, citizens of all ages。
checklist_points: 时间状语“近年来”使用 In recent years 并搭配现在完成时或一般现在时（建议 have provided / not only provide）
准确使用“不仅……而且……”结构（not only... but also...）
完整译出“免费的文化讲座和职业技能培训”及“不同年龄的市民”
句末目的/伴随状语可用 helping citizens of all ages... 或 to help...
writing_tasks.model_answer: In recent years, an increasing number of urban public libraries have not only provided quiet reading spaces, but also regularly organized free cultural lectures and career-skills training to help citizens of all ages keep learning.
writing_tasks.analysis_zh: 四级翻译常考“近年来……”与并列结构。主语用 an increasing number of urban public libraries 复数概念清晰；not only... but also... 连接两个并列过去分词短语 provided... and organized...，再用不定式 to help... 收尾表达目的。

writing_tasks.title: 短段汉译英：绿色出行与校园低碳生活
writing_tasks.prompt_zh: 请将下面这段中文短段翻译为通顺准确的英文：
writing_tasks.source_text: 为了减少校园交通拥堵和碳排放，许多高校鼓励学生优先选择步行或骑行，并改善了连接宿舍与教学楼的步道设施。
writing_tasks.hint: 参考词汇：traffic congestion, carbon emissions, give priority to, walking or cycling, connect... with...。
checklist_points: 句首目的状语“为了减少……”用 To reduce / In order to reduce
准确表达“交通拥堵和碳排放”（traffic congestion and carbon emissions）
“鼓励某人做某事”使用 encourage students to...
后半句“连接宿舍与教学楼的步道设施”可用定语从句或分词短语 connecting dormitories with teaching buildings
writing_tasks.model_answer: To reduce campus traffic congestion and carbon emissions, many universities encourage students to choose walking or cycling first and have improved footpaths connecting dormitories with teaching buildings.
writing_tasks.analysis_zh: “为了……”放在句首作目的状语非常符合英语逻辑；and 连接 encourage 和 have improved 两个并列动作时态自然；connecting... 作后置定语修饰 footpaths 简洁利落。

writing_tasks.title: 高级句型改写：用 not only... but also... 阐述 AI 学习工具的双重影响
writing_tasks.prompt_zh: 将下面两句平铺直叙的句子改写为更有论证张力的四级议论文核心句（建议使用 not only... but also... 或 While... 对比平衡观点）：
writing_tasks.source_text: AI tools help college students organize reading notes faster. However, relying on them too much may weaken independent thinking.
writing_tasks.hint: 可尝试：While AI tools..., excessive reliance on them may... 或 Not only can AI tools..., but overuse may also...
checklist_points: 准确涵盖“帮助更快整理笔记”和“过度依赖可能削弱独立思考”两面
使用动名词或名词短语（excessive reliance / overusing them）作主语使句式更凝练
避免中式表达 weaken students' think，应使用 independent thinking
writing_tasks.model_answer: While AI tools enable college students to organize reading notes efficiently, excessive reliance on them may gradually weaken independent thinking.
writing_tasks.analysis_zh: 议论文正反论证最常考让步平衡句。用 While 引导“肯定正面作用”的从句，主句使用名词化主语 excessive reliance on them 引出潜在隐忧，语气客观成熟。

writing_tasks.title: 高级句型改写：用现在分词与形式主语 It 表达“充足睡眠的价值”
writing_tasks.prompt_zh: 将下面口语化句子升级为符合四级高分标准的书面句（建议使用 It is essential / beneficial that... 或分词作伴随/结果状语）：
writing_tasks.source_text: Students should get enough sleep every night. This will make them remember vocabulary better in the morning.
writing_tasks.hint: 可尝试：Getting adequate sleep each night is essential, enabling students to...
checklist_points: 使用 adequate / sufficient 替换基础词汇 enough
将两句合并为包含动名词主语或形式主语 It 的主从/分词句
正确使用 enable sb. to do 或 retain vocabulary 表达“更好记住词汇”
writing_tasks.model_answer: Getting adequate sleep every night is crucial for college learners, enabling them to retain new vocabulary far more effectively the next morning.
writing_tasks.analysis_zh: 将第一句转化为动名词短语作主语（Getting adequate sleep），用逗号加现在分词短语 enabling them to retain... 作结果状语，避免简单句堆砌与指代模糊的 This。

writing_tasks.title: 高级句型改写：用非限制性定语从句衔接“手机提醒与深度阅读”
writing_tasks.prompt_zh: 请使用非限制性定语从句（, which...）将下面两句合并为一个流畅的学术表达：
writing_tasks.source_text: Many young readers check phone messages every few minutes. This habit breaks their focus and hurts reading comprehension.
writing_tasks.hint: 注意 , which 指代前面整句话时，从句谓语动词用单数形式！
checklist_points: 正确使用逗号 + which 引导非限制性定语从句
从句中并列谓语动词均保持第三人称单数一致（disrupts... and undermines...）
词汇升级：用 frequent message-checking / distracts / undermines 替换简单词
writing_tasks.model_answer: Many young readers check phone alerts every few minutes, which repeatedly breaks their focus and undermines reading comprehension.
writing_tasks.analysis_zh: 四级写作阅卷非常青睐“主句 + , which + 单数谓语”的评价型拓展结构。which 在此指代整件事“每几分钟看一次手机提醒”，因此 breaks 和 undermines 均须用三单形式。

writing_tasks.title: 高级句型改写：用 contribute to 与动名词升级“志愿经历与职场适应”
writing_tasks.prompt_zh: 用四级高频书面动词短语（如 contribute to / equip sb. with）改写下面这句关于校园志愿服务的句子：
writing_tasks.source_text: Doing volunteer work in the community helps students learn teamwork, and it also helps them adapt to future jobs.
writing_tasks.hint: 可尝试：Participating in community volunteer work not only..., but also contributes to...
checklist_points: 准确使用 participating in / engaging in 替换口语化的 doing
避免重复使用 helps，改用 fosters / equips / contributes to
注意 adapt to（适应）后接名词或动名词短语
writing_tasks.model_answer: Participating in community volunteer work not only fosters teamwork among students, but also contributes to their smooth adaptation to future workplaces.
writing_tasks.analysis_zh: 避免在同一句话里两次重复 helps：用 fosters teamwork 和 contributes to... 形成动词多样性；并将 adapt to future jobs 升级为名词化搭配 smooth adaptation to future workplaces。

writing_tasks.title: 短段汉译英：数字技术助力博物馆与传统文化传播
writing_tasks.prompt_zh: 请将下面这段四级常考“中国文化 + 科技”主题短段译为英文：
writing_tasks.source_text: 借助虚拟现实和数字展厅，许多中国博物馆让珍贵的历史文物在线上清晰可见，吸引了大量年轻观众主动了解传统文化。
writing_tasks.hint: 参考词汇：with the help of, virtual reality, digital exhibition halls, cultural relics, take the initiative to / actively。
checklist_points: 方式状语“借助……”使用 With the help of / Through
准确译出“珍贵的历史文物”（precious historical relics / cultural artifacts）
用 make + 宾语 + 宾补（make precious relics accessible / visible online）表达“让……可见”
用分词 attracting 或定语从句连接“吸引了大量年轻观众”
writing_tasks.model_answer: With the help of virtual reality and digital exhibition halls, many Chinese museums have made precious historical relics clearly visible online, attracting vast numbers of young visitors to actively explore traditional culture.
writing_tasks.analysis_zh: 四级真题翻译常考博物馆与数字文化主题。“让某物……可见”用 make + O + visible / accessible online 最地道；后半句用现在分词 attracting... 作自然结果状语，避免连词冗余。

writing_tasks.title: 短段汉译英：高铁网络与国内绿色周末旅游
writing_tasks.prompt_zh: 请将下面这段交通与生活方式主题短段译为通顺准确的英文：
writing_tasks.source_text: 随着全国高铁网络的不断扩展，如今人们周末跨省旅行变得更加便捷，同时也带动了沿线中小城市旅游业和地方经济的发展。
writing_tasks.hint: 参考词汇：with the expansion of, high-speed rail network, cross-province travel, boost, tourism and local economies。
checklist_points: 伴随状语“随着……不断扩展”用 With the continuous expansion of...
“使周末旅行更便捷”用 make + 宾语 + more convenient
“带动……的发展”使用 boost / promote the development of...
准确表达“沿线中小城市”（small and medium-sized cities along the routes）
writing_tasks.model_answer: With the continuous expansion of the national high-speed rail network, weekend travel across provinces has become far more convenient, while boosting tourism and local economies in small and medium-sized cities along the routes.
writing_tasks.analysis_zh: “随着……”用 With + 名词短语（expansion）比 As 从句更紧凑；用 while boosting... 引出伴随积极效应，城市定位用 along the routes 作后置定语清晰准确。

writing_tasks.title: 短段汉译英：青年志愿者与社区老年人数字助学
writing_tasks.prompt_zh: 请将下面这段“社会服务与代际互助”短段译为英文：
writing_tasks.source_text: 每个周末，大学生志愿者都会走进社区中心，耐心教老年人使用智能手机挂号就医和线上购票，帮助他们更好地融入现代数字生活。
writing_tasks.hint: 参考词汇：community centers, patiently, senior citizens, book medical appointments, integrate into。
checklist_points: 频度状语“每个周末”搭配一般现在时（visit community centers every weekend）
准确译出“挂号就医和线上购票”（book medical appointments and buy tickets online）
准确表达“帮助他们融入现代数字生活”（help them integrate smoothly into modern digital life）
writing_tasks.model_answer: Every weekend, college student volunteers visit neighborhood community centers to patiently teach senior citizens how to use smartphones to book medical appointments and purchase tickets online, helping them integrate smoothly into modern digital life.
writing_tasks.analysis_zh: 动词不定式 to patiently teach... 衔接“走进社区”的目的；teach sb. how to use... to do A and do B 结构层次分明；句末 helping them integrate into... 总结社会意义。

writing_tasks.title: 短段汉译英：传统手工艺与非遗进校园
writing_tasks.prompt_zh: 请将下面这段“非物质文化遗产传承”主题短段译为英文：
writing_tasks.source_text: 为了让更多大学生了解传统手工艺，不少高校邀请民间艺人开设选修工作坊，鼓励青年一代在实践体验中保护并创新非物质文化遗产。
writing_tasks.hint: 参考词汇：traditional handicrafts, folk artisans, elective workshops, intangible cultural heritage, preserve and innovate。
checklist_points: 目的状语用 To help more college students appreciate / learn about...
“民间艺人”译为 folk artisans / craftspeople，“选修工作坊”为 elective workshops
“非物质文化遗产”准确译为 intangible cultural heritage
准确传达“在实践体验中保护并创新”（preserve and innovate... through hands-on practice）
writing_tasks.model_answer: To help more college students appreciate traditional handicrafts, many universities invite folk artisans to offer elective workshops, encouraging the younger generation to preserve and innovate intangible cultural heritage through hands-on experience.
writing_tasks.analysis_zh: “非遗”是四级传统文化翻译高频专有名词（intangible cultural heritage）；invite sb. to do sth. 与 encouraging... through hands-on experience 构成典型“校方举措 + 育人效果”句式。

writing_tasks.title: 句式升级：用 Only 倒装结构替换平淡因果句
writing_tasks.prompt_zh: 请用“Only when... + 部分倒装”升级下面这条高分作文建议句，并突出“在日常阅读中巩固词汇”的逻辑重量：
writing_tasks.source_text: Students can truly retain unfamiliar academic words when they encounter them repeatedly in real reading contexts.
writing_tasks.hint: 提示结构：Only when students encounter unfamiliar academic words repeatedly in real reading contexts can they...
checklist_points: 将时间/条件状语从句置于句首并用 Only when 引导
主句助动词 can 正确提前到主语 students / they 之前完成部分倒装
保留 core meaning：repeatedly in authentic/real reading contexts 与 retain
整句无标点拼接错误，语气自然有力
writing_tasks.model_answer: Only when students encounter unfamiliar academic words repeatedly in real reading contexts can they truly retain and apply them with confidence.
writing_tasks.analysis_zh: 四级议论文高分句型中，“Only + 状语从句 + 部分倒装主句”是最易上手且极显结构控制力的亮点句。

writing_tasks.title: 句式升级：用现在分词作伴随/结果状语整合双短句
writing_tasks.prompt_zh: 请使用“主句 + , V-ing...”分词结构合并两句松散短句，避免连续简单句堆积：
writing_tasks.source_text: Many libraries now stay open until midnight during exam weeks. This measure provides students with a quiet harbor away from noisy dorms.
writing_tasks.hint: 参考词汇：stay open until midnight, providing students with a calm refuge / quiet study harbor。
checklist_points: 将第二句合并为逗号后的现在分词短语 providing / offering...
分词逻辑主语清晰指代前文图书馆延时的举措（结果状语）
准确保留 until midnight 与 away from noisy dorms 等细节
句式流畅紧凑，无主语漂移（dangling participle）
writing_tasks.model_answer: Many campus libraries now extend opening hours until midnight during exam weeks, providing students with a quiet study harbor far away from noisy dormitories.
writing_tasks.analysis_zh: 用“主句 + , V-ing...”替代“This measure + 动词”，可瞬间消除中式流水账感，提升句子紧凑度。

writing_tasks.title: 句式升级：用 While 引导让步对照讨论科技利弊
writing_tasks.prompt_zh: 请用 While 引导让步状语从句，把下面两句“人工智能辅助学习”平铺观点合并为一个平衡有深度的复合句：
writing_tasks.source_text: AI translation apps offer instant convenience when reading foreign articles. Over-reliance on them may weaken our independent writing skills.
writing_tasks.hint: 建议句式：While AI translation apps offer instant convenience..., heavy reliance on them risks weakening...
checklist_points: 使用 While 置于句首表示“尽管……（优势），但……”
不可在主句前再加 but
准确使用 weaken / undermine / erode 等高阶动词表达负面影响
全句平衡展现客观辩证思维
writing_tasks.model_answer: While AI translation tools provide instant convenience for grasping foreign articles, heavy reliance on them may gradually weaken our independent thinking and writing competence.
writing_tasks.analysis_zh: 四级写作讨论科技利弊话题时，While 引导的让步对照句切中评分标准中“辩证论证 + 复杂句式”的双重要求。

writing_tasks.title: 句式升级：用 Not only... but also... 与动名词作主语表达校园美育
writing_tasks.prompt_zh: 请使用“动名词短语作主语 + not only... but also...”改写升级下面句子：
writing_tasks.source_text: Volunteering in community gardens makes campus life greener. It also teaches students patience and teamwork.
writing_tasks.hint: 参考开头：Participating in / Volunteering at community gardens not only transforms...
checklist_points: 使用动名词短语 Volunteering / Participating in... 作主语（单数谓语）
正确并列 not only + 动词1 ... but also + 动词2（单三形态一致）
包含 makes campus greener 与 patience and teamwork
无双主语或谓语动词数不一致错误
writing_tasks.model_answer: Volunteering in community gardens not only makes our campus environment visibly greener but also cultivates lasting patience and practical teamwork among students.
writing_tasks.analysis_zh: 动名词作主语配合单数谓语动词是四级结尾段升华措施成效时非常稳妥的高分写法。

writing_tasks.title: 短段汉译英：新式茶空间与青年社交生活
writing_tasks.prompt_zh: 请将下面这段关于“中国茶文化现代转化”的段落译为自然地道的英文：
writing_tasks.source_text: 近年来，越来越多的城市茶馆将传统泡茶技艺与安静阅读区相结合，吸引年轻人在快节奏的工作之余放慢脚步，与朋友面对面畅谈。
writing_tasks.hint: 参考词汇：traditional brewing craft, quiet reading corners, fast-paced work, slow down, face-to-face conversations。
checklist_points: 开头时间状语使用 In recent years，主句用现在完成时或一般现在时（have combined / combine）
精准翻译“传统泡茶技艺与安静阅读区”（traditional tea-brewing craft with quiet reading zones）
准确处理目的/结果“吸引年轻人……放慢脚步”（attracting young people to slow down after fast-paced work）
自然表达“面对面畅谈”（enjoy unhurried face-to-face conversations with friends）
writing_tasks.model_answer: In recent years, a growing number of urban teahouses have combined traditional brewing craft with quiet reading zones, attracting young adults to slow down after fast-paced work and enjoy relaxed face-to-face conversations with friends.
writing_tasks.analysis_zh: 四级文化类翻译高频考查“传统元素与现代生活融合”，善用 combine A with B 及现在分词作结果状语可令译文自然连贯。

writing_tasks.title: 短段汉译英：高速铁路与区域文旅出行
writing_tasks.prompt_zh: 请将下面这段有关“交通基础设施改善出行体验”的短文译为英文：
writing_tasks.source_text: 随着高铁网络不断延伸，许多曾因路途遥远而少有人问津的山区古镇如今可在两小时内抵达，这不仅带动了当地民宿旅游，也方便外出务工人员常回家看看。
writing_tasks.hint: 参考词汇：high-speed rail network, remote mountain towns, within two hours, local homestay tourism, visit home more often。
checklist_points: 用 With the continuous expansion of... 或 As the high-speed rail network expands 译“随着延伸”
定语从句处理“曾因路途遥远而少有人问津的古镇”（ancient towns that were once rarely visited due to distance）
主句表达“两小时内可抵达”（can now be reached within two hours）
后半句使用定语从句 , which not only boosts... but also makes it easier for... 衔接
writing_tasks.model_answer: With the continuous expansion of the high-speed rail network, many ancient mountain towns that were once rarely visited due to long distances can now be reached within two hours, which not only boosts local homestay tourism but also makes it convenient for migrant workers to visit home more frequently.
writing_tasks.analysis_zh: 社会发展类翻译常考“随着某建设推进+双赢意义”，用 which 引导非限制性定语从句衔接前后因果最地道。

writing_tasks.title: 短段汉译英：社区老年助餐食堂与温情治理
writing_tasks.prompt_zh: 请将下面这段关注“基层民生服务”的段落译为英文：
writing_tasks.source_text: 为解决独居老人做饭难问题，不少街道办开设了价格实惠、营养均衡的社区食堂，还鼓励年轻上班族下班后来此就餐，营造出老少共融的暖心氛围。
writing_tasks.hint: 参考词汇：elderly residents living alone, community canteens, affordable and nutritious, young office workers, warm atmosphere。
checklist_points: 用 To ease cooking difficulties for seniors living alone 精准开头
名词搭配准确：“价格实惠、营养均衡的社区食堂”（affordable, nutritionally balanced community canteens）
准确译出“鼓励上班族就餐”（encourage young commuters to dine there after work）
结尾点睛“营造老少共融的暖心氛围”（creating a heartwarming atmosphere where generations mingle）
writing_tasks.model_answer: To ease daily cooking difficulties for elderly residents living alone, many neighborhood offices have opened affordable and nutritionally balanced community canteens, while also inviting young professionals to dine there after work and fostering a heartwarming cross-generational atmosphere.
writing_tasks.analysis_zh: 民生政策类翻译重点在于用精确动词（ease, open, invite, foster）体现政策初衷与落地成效。

writing_tasks.title: 短段汉译英：城市慢行绿道与低碳健身
writing_tasks.prompt_zh: 请将下面这段关于“绿色低碳出行”的段落译为英文：
writing_tasks.source_text: 清晨和傍晚，越来越多市民选择沿河畔健身绿道骑行或慢跑上班，这种健康低碳的出行方式正悄悄改变城市生活习惯，让繁忙街道重现鸟语花香。
writing_tasks.hint: 参考词汇：riverside greenways, cycle or jog, low-carbon commuting, quietly reshaping, urban habits, birdsong and greenery。
checklist_points: 时间状语 In the early morning and evening 置于句首
主语+动词表达“选择沿河畔绿道骑行/慢跑”（choose to cycle or jog along riverside greenways）
译出“低碳健康出行方式正在改变生活习惯”（this healthy, low-carbon habit is quietly reshaping urban routines）
准确转化“重现鸟语花香”（bringing birdsong and fragrance back to busy streets）
writing_tasks.model_answer: In the early morning and dusk, growing numbers of citizens choose to cycle or jog to work along riverside greenways; this healthy, low-carbon commuting style is quietly reshaping urban routines and bringing birdsong and greenery back to once busy streets.
writing_tasks.analysis_zh: 中文四字格“鸟语花香”译为英文时切忌生硬逐字直译，可用 bringing birdsong and greenery/fragrance back 灵活意译。

boss_challenge.title: Week 1 Station Boss: Hybrid Workplace & Focus
boss_challenge.title_zh: 第 1 周列车 Boss 战：混合办公与职场协作
boss_challenge.disclaimer: 游戏内估算表现不等于四级官方成绩，仅用于阶段性检验词汇、听力与阅读证据定位能力。

vocab_items.stem: Many tech firms adopt ____ schedules so staff can balance commuting and family duties.
vocab_items.explanation_zh: flexible 意为“灵活的、有弹性的”，flexible schedules（弹性日程）是职场类四级高频搭配。
distractor_reasons: 正确：flexible 符合“平衡通勤与家庭职责”的弹性安排语义。
错误：rigid 意为“死板的、僵硬的”，与句意相反。
错误：fragile 意为“易碎的、脆弱的”，通常不修饰日程。
错误：hostile 意为“敌对的”，词义无关。

vocab_items.stem: What does "collaborate" mean in "Engineers and writers collaborate on user guides"?
vocab_items.explanation_zh: collaborate 意为“合作、协作”，常接介词 with（与人）或 on（在某项目上）。
distractor_reasons: 正确：collaborate on 表示“在……上协作”。
错误：“竞争”对应 compete。
错误：“推迟”对应 postpone / delay。
错误：“撤回”对应 withdraw。

vocab_items.stem: In "clear weekly goals raise team productivity", "productivity" is closest to:
vocab_items.explanation_zh: productivity 意为“生产力、工作效率”，强调单位时间内的产出效率。
distractor_reasons: 正确：output efficiency（产出效率）最贴近 productivity 的核心含义。
错误：office rent 意为“办公室租金”。
错误：staff turnover 意为“员工流失率”。
错误：travel expense 意为“差旅费用”。

vocab_items.stem: New hires working remotely for months may feel ____ from experienced teammates.
vocab_items.explanation_zh: feel isolated from... 意为“感到与……孤立/疏离”，是描述远程办公心理挑战的高频表达。
distractor_reasons: 正确：isolated from 表示“与……隔离、疏离”。
错误：motivated 通常搭配 by（受到激励），不与 from 构成疏离义。
错误：adapted 搭配 to（适应）。
错误：combined 搭配 with（结合）。

listening_case.title: Midweek Core Hours Policy Briefing
listening_case.title_zh: Boss 听力：公司周中核心协作时段试行简报

transcript_lines.speaker: Operations Lead
transcript_lines.text: Good afternoon, everyone. Over the past quarter, our product team tested an open remote schedule with no fixed office days.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 大家下午好。在过去一个季度里，我们产品团队试行了不设固定到岗日的完全自由远程制度。

transcript_lines.speaker: Operations Lead
transcript_lines.text: While solo coding tasks finished faster, junior designers reported waiting up to two days for quick feedback on sketches.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 虽然独立编码任务完成得更快了，但初级设计师反映，草图往往要等上两天才有简短反馈。

transcript_lines.speaker: Operations Lead
transcript_lines.text: Therefore, starting next month, Tuesdays and Wednesdays will serve as shared studio days, while Monday, Thursday, and Friday remain flexible.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 因此，从下个月开始，周二和周三将作为共同办公日，而周一、周四和周五保持弹性安排。

transcript_lines.speaker: Operations Lead
transcript_lines.text: We will review survey results after six weeks to see whether response delays drop without hurting focus.
transcript_lines.text_zh: 我们将在六周后复核问卷结果，看回复延迟是否在不影响专注度的前提下有所下降。

questions.stem: What problem did junior designers face during the open remote trial?
options: They had to wait up to two days for feedback on sketches.
Their computers could not run design software at home.
They were asked to work six days every week.
Solo coding tasks took twice as long to finish.
questions.answer: They had to wait up to two days for feedback on sketches.

evidence_anchor.text_span: While solo coding tasks finished faster, junior designers reported waiting up to two days for quick feedback on sketches.

questions.key_evidence_line: junior designers reported waiting up to two days for quick feedback on sketches.
questions.explanation_zh: 第2句使用 While 让步对比，先说独立编码更快，紧接着指出初级设计师遇到的痛点：草图反馈等待长达两天。
distractor_reasons: 正确：直接对应第2句 waiting up to two days for quick feedback on sketches。
错误：文中未提及家用电脑软件故障。
错误：文中未要求每周工作六天。
错误：第2句明确说 solo coding tasks finished faster，与选项相反。

questions.stem: Which days will become shared studio days starting next month?
questions.answer: Tuesdays and Wednesdays.

evidence_anchor.text_span: Therefore, starting next month, Tuesdays and Wednesdays will serve as shared studio days, while Monday, Thursday, and Friday remain flexible.

questions.key_evidence_line: Therefore, starting next month, Tuesdays and Wednesdays will serve as shared studio days, while Monday, Thursday, and Friday remain flexible.
questions.explanation_zh: 第3句用 Therefore 给出新规：周二和周三（Tuesdays and Wednesdays）为共同办公日，其余三天保持弹性。
distractor_reasons: 正确：明确对应 Tuesdays and Wednesdays will serve as shared studio days。
错误：周一和周五仍属于弹性工作日。
错误：周四和周五仍属于弹性工作日。
错误：周一不在共同办公日之列。

questions.stem: When will the team review survey results on the new policy?
questions.answer: After six weeks.

evidence_anchor.text_span: We will review survey results after six weeks to see whether response delays drop without hurting focus.

questions.key_evidence_line: We will review survey results after six weeks to see whether response delays drop without hurting focus.
questions.explanation_zh: 第4句给出时间节点：review survey results after six weeks（六周后复核调查结果）。
distractor_reasons: 正确：与第4句 after six weeks 完全一致。
错误：past quarter 是上一季度试行期，不是复核周期。
错误：文中未提下周一前复核。
错误：是 six weeks，不是 six months（单位陷阱）。

reading_passage.title: Balancing Autonomy and Connection in Hybrid Teams
reading_passage.title_zh: Boss 阅读：混合办公团队如何平衡自主性与联结感

paragraphs.text: When organizations shifted toward flexible hybrid schedules, many managers feared that working away from headquarters would immediately weaken employee productivity. Early tracking studies surprised skeptics: quiet home mornings allowed analysts and writers to finish deep tasks with fewer corridor interruptions. Saving long daily commutes also left workers noticeably more energetic before afternoon calls and team reviews. Yet after the initial enthusiasm faded, a subtler organizational risk began to surface across growing departments.

Without casual desk conversations, newer staff found it harder to learn unwritten team habits or ask quick clarifying questions before minor mistakes grew costly. Over months of screen-only check-ins, some early-career hires started to feel isolated from mentors and hesitant to speak up in video meetings. Experienced teams still functioned smoothly, yet cross-department creative ideas gradually slowed down across shared quarterly projects, design sprints, and new product launches.

In response, thoughtful companies stopped treating hybrid work as a simple tug-of-war between five days at home and five days at the office. Instead, they began designing intentional office days around activities that genuinely benefit from shared presence: brainstorming sketches, onboarding new members, and resolving complex design conflicts. Meanwhile, independent writing and data analysis stayed protected at home where deep concentration came naturally to focused teams without noisy background chatter.

Researchers studying workplace adaptation conclude that location rules matter less than clear communication norms. Teams that agree on response windows, document decisions openly, and reserve meeting-free blocks consistently outperform groups that rely on constant online presence or long in-person hours. By matching the task to the setting, hybrid workplaces preserve autonomy without sacrificing human connection, mutual trust, or shared creative momentum across distributed offices, regional teams, and partner departments worldwide.

questions.stem: What did early tracking studies reveal about working during quiet home mornings?
options: Staff completed deep work with fewer hallway interruptions.
Analysts refused to submit reports from home.
Productivity dropped sharply within the first two weeks.
Managers canceled all video meetings immediately.
questions.answer: Staff completed deep work with fewer hallway interruptions.
questions.evidence_text: Early tracking studies surprised skeptics: quiet home mornings allowed analysts and writers to finish deep tasks with fewer corridor interruptions.

evidence_anchor.text_span: Early tracking studies surprised skeptics: quiet home mornings allowed analysts and writers to finish deep tasks with fewer corridor interruptions.

questions.explanation_zh: 第1段指出早期追踪研究出乎怀疑者意料：安静的居家早晨让分析员和撰稿人以更少的走廊打扰完成深度任务（hallway 对应原文 corridor）。
distractor_reasons: 正确：hallway interruptions 同义替换原文 corridor interruptions。
错误：无中生有。
错误：第1句只是管理者最初担心效率下降，实际研究显示相反。
错误：文中未说立即取消所有视频会议。

questions.stem: According to Paragraph 2, what difficulty did newer staff experience under screen-only check-ins?
options: They felt disconnected from mentors and reluctant to speak in video calls.
They had to work longer overtime hours than senior colleagues.
They could not access shared company spreadsheets.
They forgot how to collaborate with their own department.
questions.answer: They felt disconnected from mentors and reluctant to speak in video calls.
questions.evidence_text: Over months of screen-only check-ins, some early-career hires started to feel isolated from mentors and hesitant to speak up in video meetings.

evidence_anchor.text_span: Over months of screen-only check-ins, some early-career hires started to feel isolated from mentors and hesitant to speak up in video meetings.

questions.explanation_zh: 第2段第2句指出，几个月纯线上汇报后，部分职场新人感到与导师孤立疏离（isolated from mentors），并且在视频会议中不敢发言（hesitant to speak up）。
distractor_reasons: 正确：disconnected 和 reluctant 精准同义替换原文 isolated 和 hesitant。
错误：文中未提加班时长。
错误：文中未提表格访问权限。
错误：原文说跨部门创意放缓，而非忘记本部门协作。

questions.stem: How do thoughtful companies organize in-office days in Paragraph 3?
options: They reserve office days for collaborative tasks like brainstorming and onboarding.
They require employees to do all independent writing inside noisy offices.
They force every team to come in five days a week without exception.
They eliminate all face-to-face meetings to protect quiet work.
questions.answer: They reserve office days for collaborative tasks like brainstorming and onboarding.
questions.evidence_text: Instead, they began designing intentional office days around activities that genuinely benefit from shared presence: brainstorming sketches, onboarding new members, and resolving complex design conflicts.

evidence_anchor.text_span: Instead, they began designing intentional office days around activities that genuinely benefit from shared presence: brainstorming sketches, onboarding new members, and resolving complex design conflicts.

questions.explanation_zh: 第3段强调公司围绕“真正受益于共同在场”的活动设计到岗日：头脑风暴、新人融入与解决复杂设计冲突，而独立写作和数据分析则留在家里。
distractor_reasons: 正确：概括了头脑风暴与新人融入等需要协作的到岗活动。
错误：第3段末句明确指出独立写作（independent writing）留在家里受保护。
错误：第3段首句反对非黑即白的“5天在家 vs 5天到岗”拉锯战。
错误：与本段围绕面对面协作设计到岗日相反。

questions.stem: What is the authors' conclusion about successful hybrid workplaces in Paragraph 4?
options: Clear communication norms and task-setting alignment outperform rigid location rules.
Constant online presence is the only reliable proof of hard work.
Hybrid teams should stop documenting decisions to save meeting time.
Autonomy and human connection can never exist in the same company.
questions.answer: Clear communication norms and task-setting alignment outperform rigid location rules.
questions.evidence_text: Researchers studying workplace adaptation conclude that location rules matter less than clear communication norms.

evidence_anchor.text_span: Researchers studying workplace adaptation conclude that location rules matter less than clear communication norms.

questions.explanation_zh: 第4段首句和末句共同点明结论：地点规定不如清晰的沟通规范重要（location rules matter less than clear communication norms），将任务与场景匹配就能兼顾自主性与联结感。
distractor_reasons: 正确：准确概括第4段“沟通规范与任务-场景匹配胜过死板的地点规定”的核心结论。
错误：第4段第2句指出沟通规范清晰的团队胜过依赖“持续在线打卡（constant online presence）”的团队，正相反。
错误：原文提倡公开记录决策（document decisions openly），并非停止记录。
错误：末句明确说能够兼顾自主性与联结感（preserve autonomy without sacrificing human connection）。
